source_status: Supplied English records; source-edition limitations remain. No new original-language, apparatus or independent specialist verification is claimed.
completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
chapter_status_scope: Each chapters entry is one original source section; completed_chapters aggregates all source sections carrying the same native chapter number.

original_book_metadata.source_status: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

cross_references.rationale: Jeremiah announces that the Lord will show His hand and power so that people know His name is Lord. Exodus joins deliverance by an uplifted arm and great judgment to the promise that Israel will know He is the Lord their God. Both connect recognition of His name with an enacted display of His power.

target_verses.text: Go, say to the sons of Israel: ‘I am the Lord. I will bring you out from the Egyptians’ domination and deliver you from slavery. I will ransom you with an uplifted arm and with great judgment.

verses.display_text: and they hardened their neck beyond their fathers, so as not to hear Me or accept instruction.

verses.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.display_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah, saying:

verses.text: Rise and go down to the potter’s house, and there you will hear My words.
verses.display_text: Rise and go down to the potter’s house, and there you will hear My words.

verses.text: And I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.
verses.display_text: And I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was doing work upon the stones.

verses.text: And the vessel he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, as pleased him to make.
verses.display_text: And the vessel he was making fell apart in his hands, and again he made it another vessel, as pleased him to make.

verses.text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
verses.display_text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:

verses.text: Can I not shape you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, you are like the potter’s clay in My hands.
verses.display_text: Can I not shape you as this potter does, house of Israel? Behold, you are like the potter’s clay in My hands.

verses.text: At last I will speak concerning a nation or kingdom, to remove them and destroy,
verses.display_text: At last I will speak concerning a nation or kingdom, to remove them and destroy,

verses.text: and if that nation turns from all their evils, I will change My mind concerning the evils I planned to do to them.
verses.display_text: and if that nation turns from all their evils, I will change My mind concerning the evils I planned to do to them.

verses.text: And at last I will speak concerning a nation and kingdom, for it to be rebuilt and planted,
verses.display_text: And at last I will speak concerning a nation and kingdom, for it to be rebuilt and planted,

verses.text: and if they do evil things before Me by not hearing My voice, I will change My mind concerning the good things I spoke of doing for them.
verses.display_text: and if they do evil things before Me by not hearing My voice, I will change My mind concerning the good things I spoke of doing for them.

verses.text: And now say to Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Behold, I am shaping evils against you and devising a design against you. Let each turn from his evil way now, and make your practices better.
verses.display_text: And now say to Judah’s men and those dwelling in Jerusalem: Behold, I am shaping evils against you and devising a design against you. Let each turn from his evil way now, and make your practices better.

verses.text: And they said: We will be resolute, because we will follow our turnings away, and each will do what pleases his evil heart.
verses.display_text: And they said: We will be resolute, because we will follow our turnings away, and each will do what pleases his evil heart.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Ask now among the nations: Who heard such horrifying things that virgin Israel committed so greatly?
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Ask now among the nations: Who heard such horrifying things that virgin Israel committed so greatly?

verses.text: Will breasts fail from a rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water borne violently by wind turn aside?
verses.display_text: Will breasts fail from a rock, or snow from Lebanon? Will water borne violently by wind turn aside?

verses.text: Because My people forgot Me, they burned incense in vain; and they will become weak in their ways, the age-old tracks, to step upon paths having no road for travel,
verses.display_text: Because My people forgot Me, they burned incense in vain; and they will become weak in their ways, the age-old tracks, to step upon paths having no road for travel,

verses.text: to make their land a ruin and an eternal hissing; all who pass through it will be astonished and shake their head.
verses.display_text: to make their land a ruin and an eternal hissing; all who pass through it will be astonished and shake their head.

verses.text: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them their day of destruction.
verses.display_text: Like a scorching wind I will scatter them before their enemies; I will show them their day of destruction.

verses.text: And they said: Come, let us devise a design against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from a priest, counsel from the discerning, or word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and we will hear all his words.
verses.display_text: And they said: Come, let us devise a design against Jeremiah, because law will not perish from a priest, counsel from the discerning, or word from a prophet. Come, let us strike him with the tongue, and we will hear all his words.

verses.text: Listen to me, Lord, and listen to the voice of my claim of right.
verses.display_text: Listen to me, Lord, and listen to the voice of my claim of right.

verses.text: Is evil repaid for good things? For they spoke words together against my soul and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before Thee to speak good things for them, to turn Thy fury from them.
verses.display_text: Is evil repaid for good things? For they spoke words together against my soul and hid their punishment for me. Remember my standing before Thee to speak good things for them, to turn Thy fury from them.

verses.text: Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into the sword’s hands. Let their women become childless and widowed, their men killed by death, and their young men fallen by the sword in war.
verses.display_text: Therefore give their sons to famine and gather them into the sword’s hands. Let their women become childless and widowed, their men killed by death, and their young men fallen by the sword in war.

verses.text: Let there be a cry in their houses; Thou wilt bring robbers upon them suddenly, because they attempted a plan for my capture and hid traps against me.
verses.display_text: Let there be a cry in their houses; Thou wilt bring robbers upon them suddenly, because they attempted a plan for my capture and hid traps against me.

verses.text: And Thou, Lord, knewest all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices or erase their sins from before Thee. Let their weakness be before Thee; act among them in the time of Thy fury.
verses.display_text: And Thou, Lord, knewest all their counsel against me for death. Do not acquit their injustices or erase their sins from before Thee. Let their weakness be before Thee; act among them in the time of Thy fury.

verses.display_text: Then the Lord said to me: Go and acquire a molded earthenware jar, and bring some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests.

verses.text: And go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is before the Charsith Gate, and read there all the words that I speak to you.
verses.display_text: And go out to the burial ground of the sons of their children, which is before the Charsith Gate, and read there all the words that I speak to you.

verses.text: And say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, men of Judah, inhabitants of Jerusalem, and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.
verses.display_text: And say to them: Hear the Lord’s word, kings of Judah, men of Judah, inhabitants of Jerusalem, and those entering these gates. Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Behold, I am bringing evils upon this place, so that both ears of everyone hearing them will ring.

verses.text: Because they abandoned Me and alienated this place, burning incense in it to foreign gods whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and Judah’s kings filled this place with innocent blood,
verses.display_text: Because they abandoned Me and alienated this place, burning incense in it to foreign gods whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and Judah’s kings filled this place with innocent blood,

verses.text: and built high places for Baal to burn their sons in fire, things I did not command or speak of or conceive in My heart.
verses.display_text: and built high places for Baal to burn their sons in fire, things I did not command or speak of or conceive in My heart.

verses.text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Collapse or the Burial Ground of the Son of Hinnom, but the Burial Ground of Slaughter.
verses.display_text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and this place will no longer be called Collapse or the Burial Ground of the Son of Hinnom, but the Burial Ground of Slaughter.

verses.text: And I will slaughter Judah’s counsel and Jerusalem’s counsel in this place, and cast them down by the sword before their enemies and into the hands of those seeking their lives. I will give their dead as food to the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth.
verses.display_text: And I will slaughter Judah’s counsel and Jerusalem’s counsel in this place, and cast them down by the sword before their enemies and into the hands of those seeking their lives. I will give their dead as food to the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the earth.

verses.text: And I will make this city a ruin and a hissing. Everyone passing through it will look gloomy and hiss over its whole wound.
verses.display_text: And I will make this city a ruin and a hissing. Everyone passing through it will look gloomy and hiss over its whole wound.

verses.text: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and each will eat his neighbor’s flesh in the encirclement and siege with which their enemies will besiege them.
verses.display_text: And they will eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and each will eat his neighbor’s flesh in the encirclement and siege with which their enemies will besiege them.

verses.text: And smash the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,
verses.display_text: And smash the jar before the eyes of the men going out with you,

verses.text: and say: Thus says the Lord: This is how I will smash this people and this city, as an earthenware vessel is smashed that cannot be healed again.
verses.display_text: and say: Thus says the Lord: This is how I will smash this people and this city, as an earthenware vessel is smashed that cannot be healed again.

verses.text: This is what I will do, says the Lord, to this place and its inhabitants, so that this city is made like the collapsing place.
verses.display_text: This is what I will do, says the Lord, to this place and its inhabitants, so that this city is made like the collapsing place.

verses.text: And Jerusalem’s houses and the houses of Judah’s kings will be like the collapsing place of uncleannesses, in all the houses where they burned incense upon their roofs to all the host of the heavens and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.
verses.display_text: And Jerusalem’s houses and the houses of Judah’s kings will be like the collapsing place of uncleannesses, in all the houses where they burned incense upon their roofs to all the host of the heavens and poured drink offerings to foreign gods.

verses.text: And Jeremiah came from Collapse, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, stood in the courtyard of the Lord’s house, and said to all the people:
verses.display_text: And Jeremiah came from Collapse, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, stood in the courtyard of the Lord’s house, and said to all the people:

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing upon this city, all its towns, and its villages all the evils I spoke against it, because they hardened their necks so as not to listen to My words.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing upon this city, all its towns, and its villages all the evils I spoke against it, because they hardened their necks so as not to listen to My words.

verses.text: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest who had been appointed leader of the Lord’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.
verses.display_text: And Pashhur son of Immer, the priest who had been appointed leader of the Lord’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these words.

verses.text: And he struck him and put him into the trap, which was at the gate of the separated upper house that was in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: And he struck him and put him into the trap, which was at the gate of the separated upper house that was in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the trap, and Jeremiah said to him: The Lord has called your name not Pashhur but Migrant.
verses.display_text: And Pashhur brought Jeremiah out of the trap, and Jeremiah said to him: The Lord has called your name not Pashhur but Migrant.

verses.text: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I am giving you to migration with all your friends. They will fall by their enemies’ sword, and your eyes will see. I will give you and all Judah into the hands of Babylon’s king, and they will deport them and cut them down with swords.
verses.display_text: Because thus says the Lord: Behold, I am giving you to migration with all your friends. They will fall by their enemies’ sword, and your eyes will see. I will give you and all Judah into the hands of Babylon’s king, and they will deport them and cut them down with swords.

verses.text: And I will give all this city’s strength, all its labors, and all the treasures of Judah’s king into his enemies’ hands, and they will bring them to Babylon.
verses.display_text: And I will give all this city’s strength, all its labors, and all the treasures of Judah’s king into his enemies’ hands, and they will bring them to Babylon.

verses.text: And you and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. In Babylon you will die and there be buried—you and all your friends to whom you prophesied false things.
verses.display_text: And you and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. In Babylon you will die and there be buried—you and all your friends to whom you prophesied false things.

verses.text: Thou didst deceive me, Lord, and I was deceived. Thou tookest hold and didst prevail. I became a laughingstock; all day I continued being mocked.
verses.display_text: Thou didst deceive me, Lord, and I was deceived. Thou tookest hold and didst prevail. I became a laughingstock; all day I continued being mocked.

verses.text: Because I will laugh with my bitter word; I will call upon rejection and misery, because the Lord’s word became a reproach and a derision to me all day long.
verses.display_text: Because I will laugh with my bitter word; I will call upon rejection and misery, because the Lord’s word became a reproach and a derision to me all day long.

verses.text: And I said: I will certainly not name the Lord’s name or speak in His name again. And it became like a burning fire blazing in my bones; I am weakened on every side and cannot bear it.
verses.display_text: And I said: I will certainly not name the Lord’s name or speak in His name again. And it became like a burning fire blazing in my bones; I am weakened on every side and cannot bear it.

verses.text: Because I heard the reproach of many gathering all around: Rise against him, and let us rise against him, all you men who are his friends! Watch his purpose, to see whether he will be deceived and we can prevail against him and take our revenge on him.
verses.display_text: Because I heard the reproach of many gathering all around: Rise against him, and let us rise against him, all you men who are his friends! Watch his purpose, to see whether he will be deceived and we can prevail against him and take our revenge on him.

verses.text: And the Lord is with me like a strong fighter. Therefore they pursued and could not understand; they were greatly shamed, because they did not understand their dishonors, which will never be forgotten.
verses.display_text: And the Lord is with me like a strong fighter. Therefore they pursued and could not understand; they were greatly shamed, because they did not understand their dishonors, which will never be forgotten.

verses.text: Lord, testing righteous things, understanding kidneys and hearts: May I see the vengeance from Thee among them, because to Thee I disclosed my defenses.
verses.display_text: Lord, testing righteous things, understanding kidneys and hearts: May I see the vengeance from Thee among them, because to Thee I disclosed my defenses.

verses.text: Sing to the Lord; praise Him, because He rescued a poor person’s life from the hand of those doing evil.
verses.display_text: Sing to the Lord; praise Him, because He rescued a poor person’s life from the hand of those doing evil.

verses.text: Accursed be the day on which I was born! Let the day my mother bore me not be a day to pray for!
verses.display_text: Accursed be the day on which I was born! Let the day my mother bore me not be a day to pray for!

verses.text: Accursed be the man who brought my father good news, saying, A boy has been born to you!—rejoicing.
verses.display_text: Accursed be the man who brought my father good news, saying, A boy has been born to you!—rejoicing.

verses.text: Let that man be like the cities the Lord overthrew in fury without changing His mind. Let him hear a cry in the morning and a battle shout at noon,
verses.display_text: Let that man be like the cities the Lord overthrew in fury without changing His mind. Let him hear a cry in the morning and a battle shout at noon,

verses.text: because he did not kill me in my mother’s womb, so that my mother would have become my tomb and the womb one of everlasting conception.
verses.display_text: because he did not kill me in my mother’s womb, so that my mother would have become my tomb and the womb one of everlasting conception.

verses.text: Why did I come out from the womb to see labors and pains, and have my days continue in shame?
verses.display_text: Why did I come out from the womb to see labors and pains, and have my days continue in shame?

verses.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:
verses.display_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur son of Malchiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying:

verses.text: Ask the Lord about us, because Babylon’s king has come against us, whether the Lord will act according to all His wonders, so that he goes away from us.
verses.display_text: Ask the Lord about us, because Babylon’s king has come against us, whether the Lord will act according to all His wonders, so that he goes away from us.

verses.text: And Jeremiah said to them: Say this to Zedekiah king of Judah:
verses.display_text: And Jeremiah said to them: Say this to Zedekiah king of Judah:

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am turning the weapons of war with which you fight the Chaldeans who have shut you in outside the wall into this city,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am turning the weapons of war with which you fight the Chaldeans who have shut you in outside the wall into this city,

verses.text: and I Myself will fight you with outstretched hand and mighty arm, with fury, anger, and great indignation.
verses.display_text: and I Myself will fight you with outstretched hand and mighty arm, with fury, anger, and great indignation.

verses.text: And I will strike all this city’s inhabitants, the people and the livestock, with a great death, and they will die.

verses.text: And afterward—thus says the Lord—I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people remaining in this city after death, famine, and sword into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. verses.display_text: And afterward—thus says the Lord—I will give Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people remaining in this city after death, famine, and sword into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. verses.text: House of David, thus says the Lord: Judge a judgment in the morning, set things straight, and rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him, so that My anger is not kindled like fire and burns with no one to quench it.

verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Go and descend to the house of Judah’s king and speak this word there,

verses.text: and say: Hear the Lord’s word, king of Judah who sits on David’s throne—you, your household, your people, and those entering these gates.
verses.display_text: and say: Hear the Lord’s word, king of Judah who sits on David’s throne—you, your household, your people, and those entering these gates.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness; rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him. Do not oppress the newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not act impiously or shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness; rescue the plundered from the hand of the one wronging him. Do not oppress the newcomer, orphan, or widow, and do not act impiously or shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.text: Because if you truly carry out this word, kings sitting upon David’s throne and riding chariots and horses will enter this house’s gates—they, their servants, and their people.
verses.display_text: Because if you truly carry out this word, kings sitting upon David’s throne and riding chariots and horses will enter this house’s gates—they, their servants, and their people.

verses.text: But if you do not carry out these words, I swear by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.
verses.display_text: But if you do not carry out these words, I swear by Myself, says the Lord, that this house will become a desolation.

verses.text: Because thus says the Lord against the house of Judah’s king: You are Gilead to Me, the head of Lebanon; surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that will not be inhabited.
verses.display_text: Because thus says the Lord against the house of Judah’s king: You are Gilead to Me, the head of Lebanon; surely I will make you a wilderness, cities that will not be inhabited.

verses.text: And I will bring against you a destroying man and his axe, and they will cut down your chosen cedars and cast them into the fire.
verses.display_text: And I will bring against you a destroying man and his axe, and they will cut down your chosen cedars and cast them into the fire.

verses.text: And nations will pass through this city, and each will say to his neighbor: Why did the Lord act this way toward this great city?
verses.display_text: And nations will pass through this city, and each will say to his neighbor: Why did the Lord act this way toward this great city?

verses.text: And they will say: Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God, bowed down to foreign gods, and served them.
verses.display_text: And they will say: Because they abandoned the covenant of the Lord their God, bowed down to foreign gods, and served them.

verses.text: Do not weep for the dead or lament him; weep bitterly for the one going out, because he will never return or see his homeland.
verses.display_text: Do not weep for the dead or lament him; weep bitterly for the one going out, because he will never return or see his homeland.

verses.text: Because thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, who reigned in place of his father Josiah and went out from this place: He will not return there again,
verses.display_text: Because thus says the Lord concerning Shallum son of Josiah, who reigned in place of his father Josiah and went out from this place: He will not return there again,

verses.text: but in the place where I deported him, there he will die, and he will never see this land again.
verses.display_text: but in the place where I deported him, there he will die, and he will never see this land again.

verses.text: O you who build your house without righteousness and your upper rooms without judgment! He works through his neighbor without payment and will not give him his wages.
verses.display_text: O you who build your house without righteousness and your upper rooms without judgment! He works through his neighbor without payment and will not give him his wages.

verses.text: You built yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms set apart by windows, paneled with cedar and painted with red ocher.
verses.display_text: You built yourself a well-proportioned house, airy upper rooms set apart by windows, paneled with cedar and painted with red ocher.

verses.text: Will you reign because you are provoked in Ahaz your father? They will not eat or drink. It was better for you to do judgment and good righteousness.
verses.display_text: Will you reign because you are provoked in Ahaz your father? They will not eat or drink. It was better for you to do judgment and good righteousness.

verses.text: They did not know; they did not judge a case for the lowly or a case for the poor. Is this not your failing to know Me? says the Lord.
verses.display_text: They did not know; they did not judge a case for the lowly or a case for the poor. Is this not your failing to know Me? says the Lord.

verses.text: Behold, neither your eyes nor your heart are good; instead they are directed toward your greed, innocent blood to shed it, wrongdoing, and murder to commit it.
verses.display_text: Behold, neither your eyes nor your heart are good; instead they are directed toward your greed, innocent blood to shed it, wrongdoing, and murder to commit it.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: Woe upon this man! They will certainly not mourn him, O brother! Nor will they weep for him, Alas, lord!
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: Woe upon this man! They will certainly not mourn him, O brother! Nor will they weep for him, Alas, lord!

verses.text: He will be buried with a donkey’s burial; swept up, he will be thrown beyond Jerusalem’s gate.
verses.display_text: He will be buried with a donkey’s burial; swept up, he will be thrown beyond Jerusalem’s gate.

verses.text: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan and shout to the far side of the sea, because all your lovers have been shattered.
verses.display_text: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan and shout to the far side of the sea, because all your lovers have been shattered.

verses.text: I spoke to you in your falling away, and you said, I will not listen. This is your way from your youth: you did not hear My voice.
verses.display_text: I spoke to you in your falling away, and you said, I will not listen. This is your way from your youth: you did not hear My voice.

verses.text: Wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out in captivity. Then you will be ashamed and dishonored because of all who love you.
verses.display_text: Wind will shepherd all your shepherds, and your lovers will go out in captivity. Then you will be ashamed and dishonored because of all who love you.

verses.text: You who dwell in Lebanon and nest among the cedars will groan when pangs come upon you like those of a woman giving birth.
verses.display_text: You who dwell in Lebanon and nest among the cedars will groan when pangs come upon you like those of a woman giving birth.

verses.text: As I live, says the Lord, even if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, becomes a signet on My right hand, I will pull you off from there,
verses.display_text: As I live, says the Lord, even if Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, becomes a signet on My right hand, I will pull you off from there,

verses.text: and hand you into the hands of those seeking your life, those before whom you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.
verses.display_text: and hand you into the hands of those seeking your life, those before whom you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans.

verses.text: And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you both will die.
verses.display_text: And I will cast you and your mother who bore you into a land where you were not born, and there you both will die.

verses.text: But to the land for which they pray in their souls, they will certainly not return.
verses.display_text: But to the land for which they pray in their souls, they will certainly not return.

verses.text: Jeconiah was dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, because he was cast out and thrown into a land he did not know.
verses.display_text: Jeconiah was dishonored like a vessel for which there is no use, because he was cast out and thrown into a land he did not know.

verses.text: Land, land, hear the Lord’s word:
verses.display_text: Land, land, hear the Lord’s word:

verses.text: Record this man as an outcast, because no man from his offspring will grow great sitting on David’s throne and ruling again in Judah.
verses.display_text: Record this man as an outcast, because no man from his offspring will grow great sitting on David’s throne and ruling again in Judah.

verses.text: O shepherds who scatter and destroy the sheep of My pasture!
verses.display_text: O shepherds who scatter and destroy the sheep of My pasture!

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord to those shepherding My people: You scattered My sheep and drove them out without visiting them. Behold, I am exacting justice from you according to your evil practices.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord to those shepherding My people: You scattered My sheep and drove them out without visiting them. Behold, I am exacting justice from you according to your evil practices.

verses.text: And I will receive the remnant of My people from all the land where I drove them out, and establish them in their pasture; they will increase and multiply.
verses.display_text: And I will receive the remnant of My people from all the land where I drove them out, and establish them in their pasture; they will increase and multiply.

verses.text: And I will raise shepherds for them who will tend them, and they will no longer fear or be frightened, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: And I will raise shepherds for them who will tend them, and they will no longer fear or be frightened, says the Lord.

verses.text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will raise up a righteous rising for David. A king will reign and understand, doing judgment and righteousness upon the earth.
verses.display_text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will raise up a righteous rising for David. A king will reign and understand, doing judgment and righteousness upon the earth.

verses.text: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell confidently. This is his name, which the Lord will call him: Josedek.
verses.display_text: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell confidently. This is his name, which the Lord will call him: Josedek.

verses.text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives, who brought Israel’s house up from Egypt’s land,
verses.display_text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and they will no longer say, As the Lord lives, who brought Israel’s house up from Egypt’s land,

verses.text: but, As the Lord lives, who gathered all Israel’s offspring from the northern land and all the countries where He drove them out, and restored them to their land.
verses.display_text: but, As the Lord lives, who gathered all Israel’s offspring from the northern land and all the countries where He drove them out, and restored them to their land.

verses.text: Among the prophets my heart was shattered; within me all my bones were shaken. I became like a shattered man, like a person gripped by wine, before the Lord and the splendor of His glory.
verses.display_text: Among the prophets my heart was shattered; within me all my bones were shaken. I became like a shattered man, like a person gripped by wine, before the Lord and the splendor of His glory.

verses.text: Because of these things the land mourned and the wilderness pastures dried up. Their course became evil, and their strength was not so.
verses.display_text: Because of these things the land mourned and the wilderness pastures dried up. Their course became evil, and their strength was not so.

verses.text: Because priest and prophet were defiled, and in My house I saw their evils.
verses.display_text: Because priest and prophet were defiled, and in My house I saw their evils.

verses.text: Therefore let their way become a slippery place for them in darkness, and they will be tripped and fall in it, because I will bring evils upon them in their year of visitation, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Therefore let their way become a slippery place for them in darkness, and they will be tripped and fall in it, because I will bring evils upon them in their year of visitation, says the Lord.

verses.text: And among Samaria’s prophets I saw lawless acts: they prophesied through Baal and led My people Israel astray.
verses.display_text: And among Samaria’s prophets I saw lawless acts: they prophesied through Baal and led My people Israel astray.

verses.text: And among Jerusalem’s prophets I have seen horrifying things: committing adultery, walking in lies, and supporting evil hands so that no one turns from his evil way. They all became like Sodom to Me, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah.
verses.display_text: And among Jerusalem’s prophets I have seen horrifying things: committing adultery, walking in lies, and supporting evil hands so that no one turns from his evil way. They all became like Sodom to Me, and her inhabitants like Gomorrah.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from Jerusalem’s prophets defilement went out into all the land.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will feed them pain and give them bitter water to drink, because from Jerusalem’s prophets defilement went out into all the land.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Do not listen to the prophets’ words, because they make a vision futile for themselves. They speak from their own heart and not from the Lord’s mouth.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Do not listen to the prophets’ words, because they make a vision futile for themselves. They speak from their own heart and not from the Lord’s mouth.

verses.text: They say to those rejecting the Lord’s word, You will have peace. To all who walk according to their own wishes, to everyone walking in the wandering of his heart, they said, No evils will come upon you.
verses.display_text: They say to those rejecting the Lord’s word, You will have peace. To all who walk according to their own wishes, to everyone walking in the wandering of his heart, they said, No evils will come upon you.

verses.text: Because who stood in the Lord’s standing place and saw His word? Who gave ear and heard?
verses.display_text: Because who stood in the Lord’s standing place and saw His word? Who gave ear and heard?

verses.text: Behold, a shaking comes from the Lord, and anger goes out into a convulsion; swirling, it will come upon the ungodly.
verses.display_text: Behold, a shaking comes from the Lord, and anger goes out into a convulsion; swirling, it will come upon the ungodly.

verses.text: And the Lord’s fury will no longer turn back until He does it and raises it up from His heart’s undertaking. At the end of the days they will understand these things.
verses.display_text: And the Lord’s fury will no longer turn back until He does it and raises it up from His heart’s undertaking. At the end of the days they will understand these things.

verses.text: I was not sending the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.display_text: I was not sending the prophets, yet they ran; I did not speak to them, yet they prophesied.

verses.text: And if they had stood in My standing presence and listened to My words, they would have turned My people from their evil practices.
verses.display_text: And if they had stood in My standing presence and listened to My words, they would have turned My people from their evil practices.

verses.text: I am a God drawing near, says the Lord, and not a God far away.
verses.display_text: I am a God drawing near, says the Lord, and not a God far away.

verses.text: If a person hides in hidden places, will I not see him? Do I not fill the heaven and the earth? says the Lord.
verses.display_text: If a person hides in hidden places, will I not see him? Do I not fill the heaven and the earth? says the Lord.

verses.text: I heard what the prophets speak, the false things they prophesy in My name, saying, I dreamed a dream.
verses.display_text: I heard what the prophets speak, the false things they prophesy in My name, saying, I dreamed a dream.

verses.text: How long will it be in the heart of the prophets prophesying false things, and in their prophesying the wishes of their own heart?
verses.display_text: How long will it be in the heart of the prophets prophesying false things, and in their prophesying the wishes of their own heart?

verses.text: They plan to forget My law through their dreams, which each told his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name through Baal.
verses.display_text: They plan to forget My law through their dreams, which each told his neighbor, just as their fathers forgot My name through Baal.

verses.text: Let the prophet in whom there is a dream tell his dream, and the one to whom My word comes tell My word in truth. What has chaff to do with wheat? So are My words, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Let the prophet in whom there is a dream tell his dream, and the one to whom My word comes tell My word in truth. What has chaff to do with wheat? So are My words, says the Lord.

verses.text: Are not My words like blazing fire, says the Lord, and like an axe cutting rock?
verses.display_text: Are not My words like blazing fire, says the Lord, and like an axe cutting rock?

verses.text: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says the Lord God, who steal My words, each from his neighbor.
verses.display_text: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says the Lord God, who steal My words, each from his neighbor.

verses.text: Behold, I am against the prophets who cast out prophecies of the tongue and doze their own dozing.
verses.display_text: Behold, I am against the prophets who cast out prophecies of the tongue and doze their own dozing.

verses.text: Behold, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, who told them and led My people astray by their lies and wanderings. I did not send or command them, and they will bring this people no benefit at all.
verses.display_text: Behold, I am against the prophets who prophesy false dreams, who told them and led My people astray by their lies and wanderings. I did not send or command them, and they will bring this people no benefit at all.

verses.text: And if this people, a priest, or a prophet asks you, What is the Lord’s burden? say to them, You are the burden, and I will dash you down, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: And if this people, a priest, or a prophet asks you, What is the Lord’s burden? say to them, You are the burden, and I will dash you down, says the Lord.

verses.text: And the prophet, priest, or people who say, The Lord’s burden—I will exact justice from that person and his household.
verses.display_text: And the prophet, priest, or people who say, The Lord’s burden—I will exact justice from that person and his household.

verses.text: For this is what you will say, each to his neighbor and his brother: What did the Lord answer? What did the Lord speak?
verses.display_text: For this is what you will say, each to his neighbor and his brother: What did the Lord answer? What did the Lord speak?

verses.text: And do not name the Lord’s burden again, because a person’s own word will be his burden.
verses.display_text: And do not name the Lord’s burden again, because a person’s own word will be his burden.

verses.text: And why did the Lord our God speak?
verses.display_text: And why did the Lord our God speak?

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Because you said this word, The Lord’s burden, though I sent to you saying, Do not say The Lord’s burden,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord God: Because you said this word, The Lord’s burden, though I sent to you saying, Do not say The Lord’s burden,

verses.text: therefore behold, I seize you and dash you down, along with the city I gave to you and your fathers,
verses.display_text: therefore behold, I seize you and dash you down, along with the city I gave to you and your fathers,

verses.text: and I will put eternal reproach and eternal dishonor upon you, which will not be forgotten.
verses.display_text: and I will put eternal reproach and eternal dishonor upon you, which will not be forgotten.

verses.text: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs lying before the Lord’s sanctuary, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had deported Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, the rulers, craftsmen, prisoners, and rich people from Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.
verses.display_text: The Lord showed me two baskets of figs lying before the Lord’s sanctuary, after Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had deported Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, the rulers, craftsmen, prisoners, and rich people from Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon.

verses.text: One basket had very good figs, like early figs; the other basket had very bad figs that could not be eaten because of their badness.
verses.display_text: One basket had very good figs, like early figs; the other basket had very bad figs that could not be eaten because of their badness.

verses.text: And the Lord said to me: What do you see, Jeremiah? I said: Figs. The good are exceedingly good, and the bad exceedingly bad; they cannot be eaten because of their badness.
verses.display_text: And the Lord said to me: What do you see, Jeremiah? I said: Figs. The good are exceedingly good, and the bad exceedingly bad; they cannot be eaten because of their badness.

verses.text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:
verses.display_text: And the Lord’s word came to me, saying:

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Like these good figs, so I will acknowledge Judah’s deportees, whom I have sent from this place to the Chaldeans’ land, for good things.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, Israel’s God: Like these good figs, so I will acknowledge Judah’s deportees, whom I have sent from this place to the Chaldeans’ land, for good things.

verses.text: And I will fix My eyes upon them for good things and restore them to this land for good things. I will rebuild them and certainly not tear them down, plant them and certainly not pluck them out.
verses.display_text: And I will fix My eyes upon them for good things and restore them to this land for good things. I will rebuild them and certainly not tear them down, plant them and certainly not pluck them out.

verses.text: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord. They will be My people and I will be their God, because they will return to Me from their whole heart.
verses.display_text: And I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the Lord. They will be My people and I will be their God, because they will return to Me from their whole heart.

verses.text: And like the bad figs that cannot be eaten because of their badness—thus says the Lord—so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his nobles, Jerusalem’s remnant left in this land, and those dwelling in Egypt.
verses.display_text: And like the bad figs that cannot be eaten because of their badness—thus says the Lord—so I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his nobles, Jerusalem’s remnant left in this land, and those dwelling in Egypt.

verses.text: And I will give them to scattering into all the earth’s kingdoms, and they will become a reproach, a parable, an object of hatred, and a curse in every place where I drove them out.
verses.display_text: And I will give them to scattering into all the earth’s kingdoms, and they will become a reproach, a parable, an object of hatred, and a curse in every place where I drove them out.

verses.text: And I will send famine, death, and sword against them until they disappear from the land I gave them.
verses.display_text: And I will send famine, death, and sword against them until they disappear from the land I gave them.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all Judah’s people in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah,
verses.display_text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all Judah’s people in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah,

verses.text: which he spoke to all Judah’s people and Jerusalem’s inhabitants, saying:
verses.display_text: which he spoke to all Judah’s people and Jerusalem’s inhabitants, saying:

verses.text: In the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, and until this day, twenty-three years, I spoke to you, rising early and saying,
verses.display_text: In the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amos, king of Judah, and until this day, twenty-three years, I spoke to you, rising early and saying,

verses.text: and I was sending My servants the prophets to you, sending from early morning, and you did not listen or attend with your ears,
verses.display_text: and I was sending My servants the prophets to you, sending from early morning, and you did not listen or attend with your ears,

verses.text: saying: Turn, each from his evil way and from your evil practices, and you will dwell upon the land I gave to you and your fathers from age to age.
verses.display_text: saying: Turn, each from his evil way and from your evil practices, and you will dwell upon the land I gave to you and your fathers from age to age.

verses.text: Do not follow foreign gods to serve them and bow down to them, so that you do not provoke Me by your hands’ works into harming you.
verses.display_text: Do not follow foreign gods to serve them and bow down to them, so that you do not provoke Me by your hands’ works into harming you.

verses.text: And you did not hear Me.
verses.display_text: And you did not hear Me.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you did not believe My words,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you did not believe My words,

verses.text: behold, I am sending and will take the clan from the north and bring them against this land, its inhabitants, and all the surrounding nations. I will lay them waste and make them a ruin, a hissing, and eternal reproach.
verses.display_text: behold, I am sending and will take the clan from the north and bring them against this land, its inhabitants, and all the surrounding nations. I will lay them waste and make them a ruin, a hissing, and eternal reproach.

verses.text: And I will remove from them the sound of joy and delight, the sound of bridegroom and bride, the fragrance of ointment and the light of a lamp.
verses.display_text: And I will remove from them the sound of joy and delight, the sound of bridegroom and bride, the fragrance of ointment and the light of a lamp.

verses.text: And all the land will become a ruin, and they will serve among the nations for seventy years.
verses.display_text: And all the land will become a ruin, and they will serve among the nations for seventy years.

verses.text: And when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will exact justice from that nation, says the Lord, and make them an everlasting ruin.
verses.display_text: And when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will exact justice from that nation, says the Lord, and make them an everlasting ruin.

verses.text: And I will bring upon that land all My words that I spoke against it, everything written in this book. What Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
verses.display_text: And I will bring upon that land all My words that I spoke against it, everything written in this book. What Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.

verses.text: What Jeremiah prophesied concerning the nations, Elam. At the beginning of King Zedekiah’s reign, this word came concerning Elam.
verses.display_text: What Jeremiah prophesied concerning the nations, Elam. At the beginning of King Zedekiah’s reign, this word came concerning Elam.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Let Elam’s bow be shattered, the beginning of their dominion.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Let Elam’s bow be shattered, the beginning of their dominion.

verses.text: I will bring upon Elam four winds from heaven’s four ends and scatter them among all these winds. There will be no nation where Elam’s outcasts do not come.
verses.display_text: I will bring upon Elam four winds from heaven’s four ends and scatter them among all these winds. There will be no nation where Elam’s outcasts do not come.

verses.text: I will terrify them before their enemies who seek their lives and bring calamities upon them according to the anger of My wrath. I will send My sword after them until they are consumed.
verses.display_text: I will terrify them before their enemies who seek their lives and bring calamities upon them according to the anger of My wrath. I will send My sword after them until they are consumed.

verses.text: I will set My throne in Elam and send king and nobles away from there.
verses.display_text: I will set My throne in Elam and send king and nobles away from there.

verses.text: In the last days I will turn back Elam’s captivity, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: In the last days I will turn back Elam’s captivity, says the Lord.

verses.text: For Egypt, concerning the force of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, who was beside the Euphrates River at Carchemish and whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah:
verses.display_text: For Egypt, concerning the force of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, who was beside the Euphrates River at Carchemish and whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim king of Judah:

verses.text: Take up weapons and shields, and advance to war!
verses.display_text: Take up weapons and shields, and advance to war!

verses.text: Saddle the horses; mount, riders! Take your positions in your helmets. Hold your spears forward; put on your breastplates!
verses.display_text: Saddle the horses; mount, riders! Take your positions in your helmets. Hold your spears forward; put on your breastplates!

verses.text: Why are they terrified and withdrawing backward? Because their strong men will be cut down. They fled in flight and did not turn back, surrounded on every side, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Why are they terrified and withdrawing backward? Because their strong men will be cut down. They fled in flight and did not turn back, surrounded on every side, says the Lord.

verses.text: Let the swift not flee, nor the strong man escape. Northward, in the places beside the Euphrates, they grew weak and have fallen.
verses.display_text: Let the swift not flee, nor the strong man escape. Northward, in the places beside the Euphrates, they grew weak and have fallen.

verses.text: Who is this who will rise like a river, and like rivers churn water?
verses.display_text: Who is this who will rise like a river, and like rivers churn water?

verses.text: Egypt’s waters will rise like a river, and it said, I will rise and cover the land and destroy those living in it.
verses.display_text: Egypt’s waters will rise like a river, and it said, I will rise and cover the land and destroy those living in it.

verses.text: Mount the horses; prepare the chariots! Go out, warriors of the Ethiopians and Libyans equipped with weapons! And Lydians, go up and draw the bow!
verses.display_text: Mount the horses; prepare the chariots! Go out, warriors of the Ethiopians and Libyans equipped with weapons! And Lydians, go up and draw the bow!

verses.text: That day belongs to the Lord our God, a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on His enemies. The Lord’s sword will devour, be filled, and become drunk with their blood, for the Lord Sabaoth has a sacrifice from the northern land beside the Euphrates River.
verses.display_text: That day belongs to the Lord our God, a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on His enemies. The Lord’s sword will devour, be filled, and become drunk with their blood, for the Lord Sabaoth has a sacrifice from the northern land beside the Euphrates River.

verses.text: Go up, Gilead, and take resin for the virgin daughter Egypt. In vain you multiplied your remedies; there is no benefit for you.
verses.display_text: Go up, Gilead, and take resin for the virgin daughter Egypt. In vain you multiplied your remedies; there is no benefit for you.

verses.text: Nations heard your voice, and the land was filled with your cry, for warrior grew weak against warrior; both fell together.
verses.display_text: Nations heard your voice, and the land was filled with your cry, for warrior grew weak against warrior; both fell together.

verses.text: What the Lord spoke through Jeremiah concerning Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon coming to cut down Egypt’s land:
verses.display_text: What the Lord spoke through Jeremiah concerning Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon coming to cut down Egypt’s land:

verses.text: Announce to Migdol and proclaim to Memphis. Say, Take your position and prepare, for the sword has devoured your smilax growth.
verses.display_text: Announce to Migdol and proclaim to Memphis. Say, Take your position and prepare, for the sword has devoured your smilax growth.

verses.text: Why did Apis flee? Your choice calf did not remain, for the Lord disabled him.
verses.display_text: Why did Apis flee? Your choice calf did not remain, for the Lord disabled him.

verses.text: Your multitude grew weak and fell, and each spoke to his neighbor, Let us rise and return to our people, to our homeland, away from the Greek sword.
verses.display_text: Your multitude grew weak and fell, and each spoke to his neighbor, Let us rise and return to our people, to our homeland, away from the Greek sword.

verses.text: Call Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt by the name Saon-esbi-emoeed.
verses.display_text: Call Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt by the name Saon-esbi-emoeed.

verses.text: As I live, says the Lord God, like Itabyrion among the mountains and Carmel in the sea, he will come.
verses.display_text: As I live, says the Lord God, like Itabyrion among the mountains and Carmel in the sea, he will come.

verses.text: Prepare belongings for deportation, resident daughter Egypt, for Memphis will become a ruin and will be called Woe because no inhabitants remain in her.
verses.display_text: Prepare belongings for deportation, resident daughter Egypt, for Memphis will become a ruin and will be called Woe because no inhabitants remain in her.

verses.text: Egypt is a beautified heifer; a detachment from the north came against her.
verses.display_text: Egypt is a beautified heifer; a detachment from the north came against her.

verses.text: Her hired men within her are like fattened calves being fed within her. They too turned and fled together; they did not stand, for a day of destruction came upon them, the time of their vengeance.
verses.display_text: Her hired men within her are like fattened calves being fed within her. They too turned and fled together; they did not stand, for a day of destruction came upon them, the time of their vengeance.

verses.text: A sound like a hissing snake, for they will travel through sand; with axes they will come against her like woodcutters.
verses.display_text: A sound like a hissing snake, for they will travel through sand; with axes they will come against her like woodcutters.

verses.text: They will cut down her forest, says the Lord God, for it certainly cannot be estimated, for it multiplies beyond a locust swarm, and they are beyond numbering.
verses.display_text: They will cut down her forest, says the Lord God, for it certainly cannot be estimated, for it multiplies beyond a locust swarm, and they are beyond numbering.

verses.text: Daughter Egypt was put to shame, handed over to a people from the north.
verses.display_text: Daughter Egypt was put to shame, handed over to a people from the north.

verses.text: I am taking vengeance for Amon her son upon Pharaoh and those who trust him.
verses.display_text: I am taking vengeance for Amon her son upon Pharaoh and those who trust him.

verses.text: But do not fear, My slave Jacob, nor be terrified, Israel, for I am saving you from afar and your offspring from their captivity. Jacob will return, be quiet, and sleep, and no one will trouble him.
verses.display_text: But do not fear, My slave Jacob, nor be terrified, Israel, for I am saving you from afar and your offspring from their captivity. Jacob will return, be quiet, and sleep, and no one will trouble him.

verses.text: Do not fear, My servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you. I will make an end of every nation where I thrust you out, but I certainly will not make you perish. I will discipline you for judgment and certainly will not acquit you.
verses.display_text: Do not fear, My servant Jacob, says the Lord, for I am with you. I will make an end of every nation where I thrust you out, but I certainly will not make you perish. I will discipline you for judgment and certainly will not acquit you.

verses.text: The Lord’s word that He spoke against Babylon:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word that He spoke against Babylon:

verses.text: Announce among the nations and make it heard; do not hide it. Say, Babylon has been captured! Bel was disgraced, the fearless one; the delicate one was handed over, Marodach.
verses.display_text: Announce among the nations and make it heard; do not hide it. Say, Babylon has been captured! Bel was disgraced, the fearless one; the delicate one was handed over, Marodach.

verses.text: A nation came up against her from the north; it will make her land a ruin, with no one living in it, from human to livestock.
verses.display_text: A nation came up against her from the north; it will make her land a ruin, with no one living in it, from human to livestock.

verses.text: In those days and at that time, Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons will come together; walking and weeping, they will go seeking the Lord their God.
verses.display_text: In those days and at that time, Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons will come together; walking and weeping, they will go seeking the Lord their God.

verses.text: They will ask the way as far as Zion, for they will turn their faces here. They will come and take refuge with the Lord God, for an everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.
verses.display_text: They will ask the way as far as Zion, for they will turn their faces here. They will come and take refuge with the Lord God, for an everlasting covenant will not be forgotten.

verses.text: My people became lost sheep; their shepherds thrust them away and led them astray upon the mountains. They went from mountain to hill and forgot their resting place.
verses.display_text: My people became lost sheep; their shepherds thrust them away and led them astray upon the mountains. They went from mountain to hill and forgot their resting place.

verses.text: All who found them consumed them. Their enemies said, Let us not release them, because they sinned against the Lord, the pasture of righteousness, who gathered their fathers.
verses.display_text: All who found them consumed them. Their enemies said, Let us not release them, because they sinned against the Lord, the pasture of righteousness, who gathered their fathers.

verses.text: Separate yourselves from Babylon’s midst and the Chaldeans’ land; come out and become like dragons before sheep.
verses.display_text: Separate yourselves from Babylon’s midst and the Chaldeans’ land; come out and become like dragons before sheep.

verses.text: I am rousing assemblies of nations against Babylon from the north. They will deploy against her; from there she will be captured. Like a discerning warrior’s missile, it will not return empty.
verses.display_text: I am rousing assemblies of nations against Babylon from the north. They will deploy against her; from there she will be captured. Like a discerning warrior’s missile, it will not return empty.

verses.text: Chaldea will become plunder; all who plunder her will be filled.
verses.display_text: Chaldea will become plunder; all who plunder her will be filled.

verses.text: because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering My inheritance, because you leaped like little cattle in pasture and butted like bulls,
verses.display_text: because you rejoiced and boasted while plundering My inheritance, because you leaped like little cattle in pasture and butted like bulls,

verses.text: your mother was deeply ashamed—a mother for good things, last of nations, a wilderness.
verses.display_text: your mother was deeply ashamed—a mother for good things, last of nations, a wilderness.

verses.text: Because of the Lord’s anger she will not be inhabited and will entirely disappear. Everyone passing through Babylon will look gloomy, and they will hiss at every wound of hers.
verses.display_text: Because of the Lord’s anger she will not be inhabited and will entirely disappear. Everyone passing through Babylon will look gloomy, and they will hiss at every wound of hers.

verses.text: Deploy against Babylon all around, all who stretch the bow. Shoot at her; do not spare your arrows.
verses.display_text: Deploy against Babylon all around, all who stretch the bow. Shoot at her; do not spare your arrows.

verses.text: Clap against her! Her hands were disabled, her battlements fell, and her wall was demolished. For this is vengeance from God; take vengeance upon her. Do to her as she did.
verses.display_text: Clap against her! Her hands were disabled, her battlements fell, and her wall was demolished. For this is vengeance from God; take vengeance upon her. Do to her as she did.

verses.text: Destroy seed from Babylon, the one holding a sickle at harvest. Before the Greek sword, each will return to his people and flee to his land.
verses.display_text: Destroy seed from Babylon, the one holding a sickle at harvest. Before the Greek sword, each will return to his people and flee to his land.

verses.text: Israel is a wandering sheep driven away by lions. First Assyria’s king ate him; later this one, Babylon’s king, ate his bones.
verses.display_text: Israel is a wandering sheep driven away by lions. First Assyria’s king ate him; later this one, Babylon’s king, ate his bones.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I am taking vengeance upon Babylon’s king and his land, as I took vengeance upon Assyria’s king.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I am taking vengeance upon Babylon’s king and his land, as I took vengeance upon Assyria’s king.

verses.text: I will restore Israel to his pasture. He will graze on Carmel, on Ephraim’s mountain, and in Gilead, and his soul will be filled.
verses.display_text: I will restore Israel to his pasture. He will graze on Carmel, on Ephraim’s mountain, and in Gilead, and his soul will be filled.

verses.text: In those days and at that time they will seek Israel’s injustice, and it will not exist, and Judah’s sins, and they certainly will not be found, for I will be merciful to those left upon the land, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: In those days and at that time they will seek Israel’s injustice, and it will not exist, and Judah’s sins, and they certainly will not be found, for I will be merciful to those left upon the land, says the Lord.

verses.text: Go fiercely against her and her inhabitants. Take vengeance, sword, and make her disappear, says the Lord; do everything I command you.
verses.display_text: Go fiercely against her and her inhabitants. Take vengeance, sword, and make her disappear, says the Lord; do everything I command you.

verses.text: A sound of war and great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!
verses.display_text: A sound of war and great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!

verses.text: How the hammer of the whole earth was snapped and shattered! How Babylon became a ruin among nations!
verses.display_text: How the hammer of the whole earth was snapped and shattered! How Babylon became a ruin among nations!

verses.text: They will attack you and you will be captured, Babylon, without knowing it. You were found and taken because you resisted the Lord.
verses.display_text: They will attack you and you will be captured, Babylon, without knowing it. You were found and taken because you resisted the Lord.

verses.text: The Lord opened His treasury and brought out the instruments of His anger, for the Lord God has work in the Chaldeans’ land,
verses.display_text: The Lord opened His treasury and brought out the instruments of His anger, for the Lord God has work in the Chaldeans’ land,

verses.text: for her times have arrived. Open her storehouses; search her like a cave and destroy her. Let no remnant of her remain.
verses.display_text: for her times have arrived. Open her storehouses; search her like a cave and destroy her. Let no remnant of her remain.

verses.text: Dry up all her fruits, and let them go down to slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their vengeance.
verses.display_text: Dry up all her fruits, and let them go down to slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come, the time of their vengeance.

verses.text: A sound of those fleeing and being rescued from Babylon’s land, announcing in Zion vengeance from the Lord our God!
verses.display_text: A sound of those fleeing and being rescued from Babylon’s land, announcing in Zion vengeance from the Lord our God!

verses.text: Give orders against Babylon to many, to everyone drawing a bow. Encamp against her all around; let none of her people escape. Repay her according to her works; do to her all she did, for she resisted the Lord, Israel’s holy God.
verses.display_text: Give orders against Babylon to many, to everyone drawing a bow. Encamp against her all around; let none of her people escape. Repay her according to her works; do to her all she did, for she resisted the Lord, Israel’s holy God.

verses.text: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all her warriors will be thrown down, said the Lord.
verses.display_text: Therefore her young men will fall in her squares, and all her warriors will be thrown down, said the Lord.

verses.text: I am against you, insolent woman, says the Lord, for your day has come, the time of your vengeance.
verses.display_text: I am against you, insolent woman, says the Lord, for your day has come, the time of your vengeance.

verses.text: Your insolence will grow weak and fall, with no one to raise it. I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour everything around her.
verses.display_text: Your insolence will grow weak and fall, with no one to raise it. I will kindle fire in her forest, and it will devour everything around her.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons have been oppressed together. All who captured them oppressed them, because they did not want to release them.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Israel’s sons and Judah’s sons have been oppressed together. All who captured them oppressed them, because they did not want to release them.

verses.text: The One redeeming them is strong; the Lord Almighty is His name. He will judge a case against His adversaries, to remove the land, and He will provoke Babylon’s inhabitants.
verses.display_text: The One redeeming them is strong; the Lord Almighty is His name. He will judge a case against His adversaries, to remove the land, and He will provoke Babylon’s inhabitants.

verses.text: A sword against the Chaldeans, Babylon’s inhabitants, her nobles, and her discerning men!
verses.display_text: A sword against the Chaldeans, Babylon’s inhabitants, her nobles, and her discerning men!

verses.text: A sword against her warriors, and they will be disabled!
verses.display_text: A sword against her warriors, and they will be disabled!

verses.text: A sword against their horses and chariots! A sword against their warriors and the mixed people within her, and they will become like women! A sword against her treasures, and they will be scattered!
verses.display_text: A sword against their horses and chariots! A sword against their warriors and the mixed people within her, and they will become like women! A sword against her treasures, and they will be scattered!

verses.text: She trusted in her water, and they will be ashamed, for it is a land of carved images, and in the islands where they boasted.
verses.display_text: She trusted in her water, and they will be ashamed, for it is a land of carved images, and in the islands where they boasted.

verses.text: Therefore apparitions will live on the islands, and daughters of sirens will live in her. She certainly will never again be inhabited.
verses.display_text: Therefore apparitions will live on the islands, and daughters of sirens will live in her. She certainly will never again be inhabited.

verses.text: As God overturned Sodom, Gomorrah, and their bordering places, said the Lord, no person will live there, and no human being will reside there.
verses.display_text: As God overturned Sodom, Gomorrah, and their bordering places, said the Lord, no person will live there, and no human being will reside there.

verses.text: A people is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings will be roused from the earth’s farthest part,
verses.display_text: A people is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings will be roused from the earth’s farthest part,

verses.text: holding bow and dagger. It is insolent and certainly will not show mercy. Their voice will sound like the sea. They will ride horses, prepared like fire for war against you, daughter Babylon.
verses.display_text: holding bow and dagger. It is insolent and certainly will not show mercy. Their voice will sound like the sea. They will ride horses, prepared like fire for war against you, daughter Babylon.

verses.text: Babylon’s king heard the report about them, and his hands were disabled. Distress seized him, birth pains like a woman giving birth.
verses.display_text: Babylon’s king heard the report about them, and his hands were disabled. Distress seized him, birth pains like a woman giving birth.

verses.text: Like a lion he will come up from the Jordan into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her and appoint every young man over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?
verses.display_text: Like a lion he will come up from the Jordan into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her and appoint every young man over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?

verses.text: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He has planned against Babylon and His purposes against the resident Chaldeans: Surely the lambs of their sheep will be destroyed; surely pasture will disappear from them.
verses.display_text: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He has planned against Babylon and His purposes against the resident Chaldeans: Surely the lambs of their sheep will be destroyed; surely pasture will disappear from them.

verses.text: For at the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will shake, and a cry will be heard among the nations.
verses.display_text: For at the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will shake, and a cry will be heard among the nations.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: I am rousing a destroying hot wind against Babylon and against the Chaldeans who live there.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: I am rousing a destroying hot wind against Babylon and against the Chaldeans who live there.

verses.text: I will send insolent men to Babylon; they will abuse her and ravage her land. Woe upon Babylon all around on the day of her affliction!
verses.display_text: I will send insolent men to Babylon; they will abuse her and ravage her land. Woe upon Babylon all around on the day of her affliction!

verses.text: Against her let the archer stretch his bow, and let the man who has armor put it on. Do not spare her young men; obliterate her whole force.
verses.display_text: Against her let the archer stretch his bow, and let the man who has armor put it on. Do not spare her young men; obliterate her whole force.

verses.text: Wounded men will fall in the Chaldeans’ land, and pierced men outside her.
verses.display_text: Wounded men will fall in the Chaldeans’ land, and pierced men outside her.

verses.text: For Israel and Judah have not been widowed of their God, of the Lord Almighty, because their land was filled with injustice from Israel’s holy ones.
verses.display_text: For Israel and Judah have not been widowed of their God, of the Lord Almighty, because their land was filled with injustice from Israel’s holy ones.

verses.text: Flee from Babylon’s midst; each of you save your life. Do not be cast away in her injustice, for her time of vengeance is from the Lord; He is repaying her recompense.
verses.display_text: Flee from Babylon’s midst; each of you save your life. Do not be cast away in her injustice, for her time of vengeance is from the Lord; He is repaying her recompense.

verses.text: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, making the whole earth drunk. Nations drank her wine; therefore they were shaken.
verses.display_text: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, making the whole earth drunk. Nations drank her wine; therefore they were shaken.

verses.text: Suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament her! Take resin for her corruption, if somehow she may be healed.
verses.display_text: Suddenly Babylon fell and was shattered. Lament her! Take resin for her corruption, if somehow she may be healed.

verses.text: We treated Babylon, but she was not healed. Let us leave her; let each of us go to our own land, for her judgment reached heaven and rose to the stars.
verses.display_text: We treated Babylon, but she was not healed. Let us leave her; let each of us go to our own land, for her judgment reached heaven and rose to the stars.

verses.text: The Lord has brought forth His judgment. Come, let us announce in Zion the works of the Lord our God.
verses.display_text: The Lord has brought forth His judgment. Come, let us announce in Zion the works of the Lord our God.

verses.text: Prepare the arrows; fill the quivers. The Lord roused the spirit of the Medes’ king, for His anger against Babylon is to destroy her. This is the Lord’s vengeance, vengeance for His people.
verses.display_text: Prepare the arrows; fill the quivers. The Lord roused the spirit of the Medes’ king, for His anger against Babylon is to destroy her. This is the Lord’s vengeance, vengeance for His people.

verses.text: Raise a signal on Babylon’s walls; set up quivers, raise guards, prepare weapons, for the Lord has undertaken and will do what He spoke against Babylon’s inhabitants,
verses.display_text: Raise a signal on Babylon’s walls; set up quivers, raise guards, prepare weapons, for the Lord has undertaken and will do what He spoke against Babylon’s inhabitants,

verses.text: who dwell beside many waters and her abundance of treasures. Your end has truly come to your inward parts.
verses.display_text: who dwell beside many waters and her abundance of treasures. Your end has truly come to your inward parts.

verses.text: For the Lord swore by His arm: I will fill you with people like locusts, and those coming down will speak out against you.
verses.display_text: For the Lord swore by His arm: I will fill you with people like locusts, and those coming down will speak out against you.

verses.text: He makes the earth by His strength, prepares the inhabited world by His wisdom, and stretched out heaven by His understanding.
verses.display_text: He makes the earth by His strength, prepares the inhabited world by His wisdom, and stretched out heaven by His understanding.

verses.text: At His voice He set a sound of water in heaven and brought clouds up from the earth’s end. He made lightning for rain and brought light out of His treasuries.
verses.display_text: At His voice He set a sound of water in heaven and brought clouds up from the earth’s end. He made lightning for rain and brought light out of His treasuries.

verses.text: Every person became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was disgraced by his carvings, because they cast false things, and there is no spirit in them.
verses.display_text: Every person became foolish, without knowledge; every goldsmith was disgraced by his carvings, because they cast false things, and there is no spirit in them.

verses.text: They are vain, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.
verses.display_text: They are vain, mocked works; at the time of their visitation they will perish.

verses.text: Jacob’s portion is not like this, for the One who formed all things is Himself his inheritance. The Lord is His name.
verses.display_text: Jacob’s portion is not like this, for the One who formed all things is Himself his inheritance. The Lord is His name.
