verses.text: You scatter instruments of war for Me. In you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.
verses.display_text: You scatter instruments of war for Me. In you I will scatter nations, and from you I will remove kings.

verses.text: In you I will scatter horse and rider; in you I will scatter chariots and their riders.
verses.display_text: In you I will scatter horse and rider; in you I will scatter chariots and their riders.

verses.text: In you I will scatter young man and virgin; in you I will scatter man and woman.
verses.display_text: In you I will scatter young man and virgin; in you I will scatter man and woman.

verses.text: In you I will scatter shepherd and flock; in you I will scatter farmer and farmland; in you I will scatter your leaders and generals.
verses.display_text: In you I will scatter shepherd and flock; in you I will scatter farmer and farmland; in you I will scatter your leaders and generals.

verses.text: I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldeans who live there for all the evils they did against Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will repay Babylon and all the Chaldeans who live there for all the evils they did against Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.

verses.text: I am against you, ruined mountain that ruins the whole earth. I will stretch My hand against you, roll you down from the rocks, and make you like a burned mountain.
verses.display_text: I am against you, ruined mountain that ruins the whole earth. I will stretch My hand against you, roll you down from the rocks, and make you like a burned mountain.

verses.text: They will certainly not take from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, for you will be a ruin for ever, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: They will certainly not take from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, for you will be a ruin for ever, says the Lord.

verses.text: Raise a signal on the earth; sound a trumpet among the nations. Consecrate nations against her; give orders against her to Ararat’s kingdoms from Me and to the Ashkenazites. Set up arrow batteries against her; bring up horses against her like a multitude of locusts.
verses.display_text: Raise a signal on the earth; sound a trumpet among the nations. Consecrate nations against her; give orders against her to Ararat’s kingdoms from Me and to the Ashkenazites. Set up arrow batteries against her; bring up horses against her like a multitude of locusts.

verses.text: Consecrate nations against her: the king of the Medes and of all the earth, his leaders and all his generals.
verses.display_text: Consecrate nations against her: the king of the Medes and of all the earth, his leaders and all his generals.

verses.text: The earth was shaken and suffered, for the Lord’s purpose rose against Babylon, to make Babylon’s land a ruin, no longer inhabited.
verses.display_text: The earth was shaken and suffered, for the Lord’s purpose rose against Babylon, to make Babylon’s land a ruin, no longer inhabited.

verses.text: Babylon’s warrior has ceased fighting; they will sit there in confinement. Their power was crushed; they became like women. Her dwellings were burned; her bars were shattered.
verses.display_text: Babylon’s warrior has ceased fighting; they will sit there in confinement. Their power was crushed; they became like women. Her dwellings were burned; her bars were shattered.

verses.text: Pursuer will pursue to meet pursuer, and announcer to meet announcer, to tell Babylon’s king that his city has been captured;
verses.display_text: Pursuer will pursue to meet pursuer, and announcer to meet announcer, to tell Babylon’s king that his city has been captured;

verses.text: from the extremity of his crossings they were taken, and their gatherings were burned with fire, and his warriors are going out.
verses.display_text: from the extremity of his crossings they were taken, and their gatherings were burned with fire, and his warriors are going out.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: The houses of Babylon’s king will be threshed like a threshing floor ready for use; a little longer, and her harvest will come.
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: The houses of Babylon’s king will be threshed like a threshing floor ready for use; a little longer, and her harvest will come.

verses.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon devoured me, divided me, seized me, a thin vessel. He swallowed me like a dragon, filled his belly, and drove me from my luxury.
verses.display_text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon devoured me, divided me, seized me, a thin vessel. He swallowed me like a dragon, filled his belly, and drove me from my luxury.

verses.text: My toils and miseries be upon Babylon, the woman dwelling in Zion will say; my blood be upon the Chaldeans who live there, Jerusalem will say.
verses.display_text: My toils and miseries be upon Babylon, the woman dwelling in Zion will say; my blood be upon the Chaldeans who live there, Jerusalem will say.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will judge your adversary and avenge you; I will lay her sea waste and dry her spring.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I will judge your adversary and avenge you; I will lay her sea waste and dry her spring.

verses.text: Babylon will become a ruin and will not be inhabited.
verses.display_text: Babylon will become a ruin and will not be inhabited.

verses.text: Together they were roused like lions and like lions’ cubs.
verses.display_text: Together they were roused like lions and like lions’ cubs.

verses.text: In their heat I will give them a drink and make them drunk, so that they are stupefied and sleep an everlasting sleep and certainly do not rise, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: In their heat I will give them a drink and make them drunk, so that they are stupefied and sleep an everlasting sleep and certainly do not rise, says the Lord.

verses.text: I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with young goats.
verses.display_text: I will bring them down like lambs to slaughter and like rams with young goats.

verses.text: How the boast of the whole earth was captured and hunted! How Babylon became a ruin among the nations!
verses.display_text: How the boast of the whole earth was captured and hunted! How Babylon became a ruin among the nations!

verses.text: The sea rose over Babylon with the sound of its waves, and she was covered.
verses.display_text: The sea rose over Babylon with the sound of its waves, and she was covered.

verses.text: Her cities became a waterless and untrodden land; not one person will live there, nor will any human lodge there.
verses.display_text: Her cities became a waterless and untrodden land; not one person will live there, nor will any human lodge there.

verses.text: I will exact vengeance on Babylon and bring what she swallowed out of her mouth. Nations will certainly no longer gather to her.
verses.display_text: I will exact vengeance on Babylon and bring what she swallowed out of her mouth. Nations will certainly no longer gather to her.

verses.text: And in Babylon wounded men from all the earth will fall.
verses.display_text: And in Babylon wounded men from all the earth will fall.

verses.text: You who escape from the land, go on; do not stand still. You who are far away, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem rise in your hearts.
verses.display_text: You who escape from the land, go on; do not stand still. You who are far away, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem rise in your hearts.

verses.text: We were disgraced, for we heard our reproach; dishonor covered our face. Foreigners entered our holy places, the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: We were disgraced, for we heard our reproach; dishonor covered our face. Foreigners entered our holy places, the Lord’s house.

verses.text: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will exact vengeance on her carvings, and wounded men will fall throughout her land.
verses.display_text: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will exact vengeance on her carvings, and wounded men will fall throughout her land.

verses.text: Even if Babylon rises as high as heaven and fortifies the height of her strength, those who destroy her will come from Me, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Even if Babylon rises as high as heaven and fortifies the height of her strength, those who destroy her will come from Me, says the Lord.

verses.text: A sound of crying in Babylon, a great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!
verses.display_text: A sound of crying in Babylon, a great shattering in the Chaldeans’ land!

verses.text: For the Lord destroyed Babylon and silenced her loud voice sounding like many waters; He gave her voice over to destruction.
verses.display_text: For the Lord destroyed Babylon and silenced her loud voice sounding like many waters; He gave her voice over to destruction.

verses.text: For misery came upon Babylon. Her warriors were captured; their bow is terrified, because God repays them; the Lord repays her recompense.
verses.display_text: For misery came upon Babylon. Her warriors were captured; their bow is terrified, because God repays them; the Lord repays her recompense.

verses.text: He will make her leaders and wise men and generals thoroughly drunk, says the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.
verses.display_text: He will make her leaders and wise men and generals thoroughly drunk, says the King, whose name is the Lord Almighty.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Babylon’s wall was broadened; it will be utterly demolished, and her high gates burned. Peoples will not labor in vain, and nations will perish at the beginning.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Babylon’s wall was broadened; it will be utterly demolished, and her high gates burned. Peoples will not labor in vain, and nations will perish at the beginning.

verses.text: The word the Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to tell Seraiah son of Neriah son of Maaseiah when he went from Zedekiah king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Seraiah was an official over gifts.
verses.display_text: The word the Lord commanded Jeremiah the prophet to tell Seraiah son of Neriah son of Maaseiah when he went from Zedekiah king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Seraiah was an official over gifts.

verses.text: Jeremiah wrote in one scroll all the evils that would come upon Babylon, all these words written against Babylon.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah wrote in one scroll all the evils that would come upon Babylon, all these words written against Babylon.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to Seraiah: When you arrive in Babylon, you will see and read all these words,
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to Seraiah: When you arrive in Babylon, you will see and read all these words,

verses.text: and say, Lord, Lord, Thou spakest against this place to destroy it and leave no inhabitants in it, from human to livestock, for it will be a ruin for ever.
verses.display_text: and say, Lord, Lord, Thou spakest against this place to destroy it and leave no inhabitants in it, from human to livestock, for it will be a ruin for ever.

verses.text: When you finish reading this scroll, bind a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates,
verses.display_text: When you finish reading this scroll, bind a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates,

verses.text: and say, Thus Babylon will sink and certainly not rise because of the evils I am bringing upon her.
verses.display_text: and say, Thus Babylon will sink and certainly not rise because of the evils I am bringing upon her.

verses.text: Concerning the people of another tribe.
verses.display_text: Concerning the people of another tribe.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Waters are rising from the north and will become a flooding torrent. It will flood the land and its fullness, the city and those living in it. People will cry out, and all the land’s inhabitants will shout aloud.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Waters are rising from the north and will become a flooding torrent. It will flood the land and its fullness, the city and those living in it. People will cry out, and all the land’s inhabitants will shout aloud.

verses.text: At the sound of his onrush, of the hooves of his feet, the shaking of his chariots, and the noise of his wheels, fathers did not turn back to their sons, because their hands failed,
verses.display_text: At the sound of his onrush, of the hooves of his feet, the shaking of his chariots, and the noise of his wheels, fathers did not turn back to their sons, because their hands failed,

verses.text: on the day coming to destroy all the people of another tribe. I will obliterate Tyre and Sidon and all the remainder of their assistance, for the Lord will destroy the survivors of the islands.
verses.display_text: on the day coming to destroy all the people of another tribe. I will obliterate Tyre and Sidon and all the remainder of their assistance, for the Lord will destroy the survivors of the islands.

verses.text: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon and the survivors of the Anakim have been cast away. How long will you strike,
verses.display_text: Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon and the survivors of the Anakim have been cast away. How long will you strike,

verses.text: sword of the Lord? How long will you not be quiet? Return to your sheath; rest and be lifted away!
verses.display_text: sword of the Lord? How long will you not be quiet? Return to your sheath; rest and be lifted away!

verses.text: How will it be quiet? The Lord commanded it to rise against Ashkelon, against the coastal places, against those remaining.
verses.display_text: How will it be quiet? The Lord commanded it to rise against Ashkelon, against the coastal places, against those remaining.

verses.text: For Idumea, thus says the Lord: There is no longer wisdom in Teman; counsel perished from the discerning; their wisdom went away.
verses.display_text: For Idumea, thus says the Lord: There is no longer wisdom in Teman; counsel perished from the discerning; their wisdom went away.

verses.text: Their place was deceived. Go deep to dwell, inhabitants of Dedan, for he did difficult things; I brought them upon him at the time I visited him.
verses.display_text: Their place was deceived. Go deep to dwell, inhabitants of Dedan, for he did difficult things; I brought them upon him at the time I visited him.

verses.text: For grape gatherers came to you; they will leave you no remnants. Like thieves by night they will lay their hand upon you.
verses.display_text: For grape gatherers came to you; they will leave you no remnants. Like thieves by night they will lay their hand upon you.

verses.text: For I dragged Esau away and uncovered their secrets; they certainly cannot hide. They perished by the hand of his brother and his neighbor, and it is not possible
verses.display_text: For I dragged Esau away and uncovered their secrets; they certainly cannot hide. They perished by the hand of his brother and his neighbor, and it is not possible

verses.text: for your orphan to remain so that he may live. And I will live, and widows have trusted in Me.
verses.display_text: for your orphan to remain so that he may live. And I will live, and widows have trusted in Me.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: Those for whom there was no law to drink the cup drank it. And you, though acquitted, certainly will not be acquitted, for you will certainly drink.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: Those for whom there was no law to drink the cup drank it. And you, though acquitted, certainly will not be acquitted, for you will certainly drink.

verses.text: For I swore by Myself, says the Lord, that you will become an untrodden place, a reproach, and a curse in her midst, and all her cities will be deserted for ever.
verses.display_text: For I swore by Myself, says the Lord, that you will become an untrodden place, a reproach, and a curse in her midst, and all her cities will be deserted for ever.

verses.text: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent messengers to the nations: Gather and come against her; rise for war!
verses.display_text: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent messengers to the nations: Gather and come against her; rise for war!

verses.text: I made you small among nations, easily despised among people.
verses.display_text: I made you small among nations, easily despised among people.

verses.text: Your playfulness assailed you; your heart’s insolence destroyed holes in rocks and seized the strength of a high hill. For he raised his nest like an eagle; from there I will bring you down.
verses.display_text: Your playfulness assailed you; your heart’s insolence destroyed holes in rocks and seized the strength of a high hill. For he raised his nest like an eagle; from there I will bring you down.

verses.text: Idumea will become an untrodden place; everyone passing by her will hiss.
verses.display_text: Idumea will become an untrodden place; everyone passing by her will hiss.

verses.text: As Sodom, Gomorrah, and her neighboring places were overturned, said the Lord Almighty, no person will settle there, and no human being will live there.
verses.display_text: As Sodom, Gomorrah, and her neighboring places were overturned, said the Lord Almighty, no person will settle there, and no human being will live there.

verses.text: Like a lion he will come up from Jordan’s midst into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her. Appoint the young men over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?
verses.display_text: Like a lion he will come up from Jordan’s midst into Aitham’s place, for I will quickly drive them away from her. Appoint the young men over her. For who is like Me? Who will resist Me, and what shepherd can stand before Me?

verses.text: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He planned against Idumea and His purpose against Teman’s inhabitants: Surely the smallest sheep will be swept together; surely their dwelling will be made untrodden over her.
verses.display_text: Therefore hear the Lord’s counsel that He planned against Idumea and His purpose against Teman’s inhabitants: Surely the smallest sheep will be swept together; surely their dwelling will be made untrodden over her.

verses.text: For at the sound of their fall the earth shook, and your cry was heard at the sea.
verses.display_text: For at the sound of their fall the earth shook, and your cry was heard at the sea.

verses.text: Like an eagle he will look and stretch his wings over her fortifications. That day Idumea’s strong men’s hearts will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
verses.display_text: Like an eagle he will look and stretch his wings over her fortifications. That day Idumea’s strong men’s hearts will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

verses.text: For Ammon’s sons, thus said the Lord: Are there no sons in Israel, or have they no one to inherit? Why did Melchom take Gad, and will their people live in their cities?
verses.display_text: For Ammon’s sons, thus said the Lord: Are there no sons in Israel, or have they no one to inherit? Why did Melchom take Gad, and will their people live in their cities?

verses.text: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make the din of wars heard against Rabbath. They will become an untrodden place and a destruction, her altars will be burned with fire, and Israel will receive his rule.
verses.display_text: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make the din of wars heard against Rabbath. They will become an untrodden place and a destruction, her altars will be burned with fire, and Israel will receive his rule.

verses.text: Shout aloud, Heshbon, for Gai perished! Cry out, daughters of Rabbath; put on sackcloth, be seized with distress, and beat yourselves over Melchom, for he will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.
verses.display_text: Shout aloud, Heshbon, for Gai perished! Cry out, daughters of Rabbath; put on sackcloth, be seized with distress, and beat yourselves over Melchom, for he will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.

verses.text: Why do you exult in the plains of the Anakim, daughter of dishonor, trusting in her treasures and saying, Who will come against me?
verses.display_text: Why do you exult in the plains of the Anakim, daughter of dishonor, trusting in her treasures and saying, Who will come against me?

verses.text: I am bringing fear upon you, said the Lord, from all your surroundings. You will be scattered, each straight ahead, and there will be no one gathering.
verses.display_text: I am bringing fear upon you, said the Lord, from all your surroundings. You will be scattered, each straight ahead, and there will be no one gathering.

verses.text: For Kedar, queen of the courtyard, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. Thus said the Lord: Rise and go up against Kedar, and fill the sons of Kedem!
verses.display_text: For Kedar, queen of the courtyard, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. Thus said the Lord: Rise and go up against Kedar, and fill the sons of Kedem!

verses.text: They will take their tents and sheep, their garments, all their equipment, and camels for themselves. Call destruction against them on every side!
verses.display_text: They will take their tents and sheep, their garments, all their equipment, and camels for themselves. Call destruction against them on every side!

verses.text: Flee far away; go deep to dwell, you who stay in the courtyard, for Babylon’s king planned counsel against you and devised a purpose against you.
verses.display_text: Flee far away; go deep to dwell, you who stay in the courtyard, for Babylon’s king planned counsel against you and devised a purpose against you.

verses.text: Rise and go up against a stable nation living in refreshment, with neither doors nor pins nor bars; they lodge alone.
verses.display_text: Rise and go up against a stable nation living in refreshment, with neither doors nor pins nor bars; they lodge alone.

verses.text: Their camels will become plunder and their numerous livestock destruction. I will winnow them to every wind, those shorn before their faces; from every side of them I will bring their rout, said the Lord.
verses.display_text: Their camels will become plunder and their numerous livestock destruction. I will winnow them to every wind, those shorn before their faces; from every side of them I will bring their rout, said the Lord.

verses.text: The courtyard will become an abode for ostriches, untrodden for ever. No person will settle there; no human being will live there.
verses.display_text: The courtyard will become an abode for ostriches, untrodden for ever. No person will settle there; no human being will live there.

verses.text: For Damascus: Hamath and Arpad were ashamed because they heard an evil report. They were distraught and angry; they certainly cannot rest.
verses.display_text: For Damascus: Hamath and Arpad were ashamed because they heard an evil report. They were distraught and angry; they certainly cannot rest.

verses.text: Damascus grew feeble and turned to flight; trembling seized her.
verses.display_text: Damascus grew feeble and turned to flight; trembling seized her.

verses.text: How did he not abandon My city? They loved a village.
verses.display_text: How did he not abandon My city? They loved a village.

verses.text: Therefore young men will fall in your squares, and all your warriors will fall, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Therefore young men will fall in your squares, and all your warriors will fall, says the Lord.

verses.text: I will kindle fire in Damascus’s wall, and it will devour the quarters of Ader’s son.
verses.display_text: I will kindle fire in Damascus’s wall, and it will devour the quarters of Ader’s son.

verses.text: For Moab, thus said the Lord: Woe to Nebo, for she perished! Kiriathaim was taken; Amath was disgraced and defeated.
verses.display_text: For Moab, thus said the Lord: Woe to Nebo, for she perished! Kiriathaim was taken; Amath was disgraced and defeated.

verses.text: There is no longer healing for Moab, a boast in Heshbon. They devised evils against her: We cut her off from a nation, and she will certainly cease. A sword will walk behind you.
verses.display_text: There is no longer healing for Moab, a boast in Heshbon. They devised evils against her: We cut her off from a nation, and she will certainly cease. A sword will walk behind you.

verses.text: For a sound of people crying out comes from Horonaim: destruction and great shattering!
verses.display_text: For a sound of people crying out comes from Horonaim: destruction and great shattering!

verses.text: Moab was shattered; announce it in Zogora.
verses.display_text: Moab was shattered; announce it in Zogora.

verses.text: For Alaoth was filled with weeping; he will go up weeping on Horonaim’s road. You heard a cry of shattering:
verses.display_text: For Alaoth was filled with weeping; he will go up weeping on Horonaim’s road. You heard a cry of shattering:

verses.text: Flee and save your lives, and you will be like a wild donkey in the wilderness!
verses.display_text: Flee and save your lives, and you will be like a wild donkey in the wilderness!

verses.text: Because you trusted in your fortifications, you too will be seized. Chemosh will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.
verses.display_text: Because you trusted in your fortifications, you too will be seized. Chemosh will go into deportation, his priests and rulers together.

verses.text: Destruction will come upon every city; no city will be saved. The valley will perish and the plain be destroyed, as the Lord said.
verses.display_text: Destruction will come upon every city; no city will be saved. The valley will perish and the plain be destroyed, as the Lord said.

verses.text: Give signs to Moab, for she will surely be kindled; all her cities will become an untrodden place. From where will an inhabitant come to her?
verses.display_text: Give signs to Moab, for she will surely be kindled; all her cities will become an untrodden place. From where will an inhabitant come to her?

verses.text: Accursed is one who does the Lord’s works carelessly, removing his sword from blood.
verses.display_text: Accursed is one who does the Lord’s works carelessly, removing his sword from blood.

verses.text: Moab rested from childhood and trusted in his glory. He did not pour from vessel to vessel or go into deportation. Therefore his taste remained in him and his scent did not fade.
verses.display_text: Moab rested from childhood and trusted in his glory. He did not pour from vessel to vessel or go into deportation. Therefore his taste remained in him and his scent did not fade.

verses.text: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will send him tilters who will tip him, thin out his vessels, and cut up his horns.
verses.display_text: Therefore days are coming, says the Lord, when I will send him tilters who will tip him, thin out his vessels, and cut up his horns.

verses.text: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel’s house was ashamed of Bethel, their hope, having trusted in them.
verses.display_text: Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as Israel’s house was ashamed of Bethel, their hope, having trusted in them.

verses.text: How will you say, We are strong, and a man strong for warfare?
verses.display_text: How will you say, We are strong, and a man strong for warfare?

verses.text: Moab perished, his city, and his choice young men went down to slaughter.
verses.display_text: Moab perished, his city, and his choice young men went down to slaughter.

verses.text: Moab’s day is near to coming, and his calamity is very swift.
verses.display_text: Moab’s day is near to coming, and his calamity is very swift.

verses.text: Move in lament for him, all who surround him, all who know his name. Say, How the renowned staff is shattered, the rod of grandeur!
verses.display_text: Move in lament for him, all who surround him, all who know his name. Say, How the renowned staff is shattered, the rod of grandeur!

verses.text: Come down from glory and sit in dampness, resident Dibon. Be crushed, for Moab perished; he came up against you, ruining your fortification.
verses.display_text: Come down from glory and sit in dampness, resident Dibon. Be crushed, for Moab perished; he came up against you, ruining your fortification.

verses.text: Stand on the road and look, you who live in Aroer. Ask the one fleeing and the one being saved, and say, What happened?
verses.display_text: Stand on the road and look, you who live in Aroer. Ask the one fleeing and the one being saved, and say, What happened?

verses.text: Moab was ashamed, for he was shattered. Wail and cry out; announce at Arnon that Moab perished.
verses.display_text: Moab was ashamed, for he was shattered. Wail and cry out; announce at Arnon that Moab perished.

verses.text: Judgment is coming into the land of Misor: upon Chailon, Jahzah, and Mophath,
verses.display_text: Judgment is coming into the land of Misor: upon Chailon, Jahzah, and Mophath,

verses.text: upon Dibon, Nebo, and the house of Deblathaim,
verses.display_text: upon Dibon, Nebo, and the house of Deblathaim,

verses.text: upon Kiriathaim, the house of Gamol, and the house of Maon,
verses.display_text: upon Kiriathaim, the house of Gamol, and the house of Maon,

verses.text: upon Kerioth, Bosor, and all Moab’s cities, far and near.
verses.display_text: upon Kerioth, Bosor, and all Moab’s cities, far and near.

verses.text: Moab’s horn was broken and his effort shattered.
verses.display_text: Moab’s horn was broken and his effort shattered.

verses.text: Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the Lord. Moab will strike with his hand and become a laughingstock himself.
verses.display_text: Make him drunk, for he magnified himself against the Lord. Moab will strike with his hand and become a laughingstock himself.

verses.text: Was not Israel a laughingstock to you? Was he found in your thefts, that you made war on him?
verses.display_text: Was not Israel a laughingstock to you? Was he found in your thefts, that you made war on him?

verses.text: Moab’s inhabitants left the cities and lived among rocks. They became like doves nesting among rocks at a pit’s mouth.
verses.display_text: Moab’s inhabitants left the cities and lived among rocks. They became like doves nesting among rocks at a pit’s mouth.

verses.text: I heard Moab’s insolence; he acted very insolently—his insolence and arrogance—and his heart was lifted up.
verses.display_text: I heard Moab’s insolence; he acted very insolently—his insolence and arrogance—and his heart was lifted up.

verses.text: But I knew his works. Not his sufficiency; he did not act so.
verses.display_text: But I knew his works. Not his sufficiency; he did not act so.

verses.text: Therefore wail over Moab from every side; cry out over the men of Kiradas of drought.
verses.display_text: Therefore wail over Moab from every side; cry out over the men of Kiradas of drought.

verses.text: Like the weeping for Jazer, I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches crossed the sea and reached Jazer. Destruction fell upon your summer fruit and your grape gatherers.
verses.display_text: Like the weeping for Jazer, I will weep for you, vine of Sibmah. Your branches crossed the sea and reached Jazer. Destruction fell upon your summer fruit and your grape gatherers.

verses.text: Joy and gladness were boiled away from Moab’s land, and wine was upon your winepresses. They did not tread in the morning or in the evening; they did not make an aidad shout.
verses.display_text: Joy and gladness were boiled away from Moab’s land, and wine was upon your winepresses. They did not tread in the morning or in the evening; they did not make an aidad shout.

verses.text: From Heshbon’s cry as far as Elealeh, their cities raised their voice; from Zogor to Horonaim and Aglath-salisia, for even Nebrim’s water will become a burning.
verses.display_text: From Heshbon’s cry as far as Elealeh, their cities raised their voice; from Zogor to Horonaim and Aglath-salisia, for even Nebrim’s water will become a burning.

verses.text: I will destroy Moab, says the Lord, as he goes up to an altar and burns incense to his gods.
verses.display_text: I will destroy Moab, says the Lord, as he goes up to an altar and burns incense to his gods.

verses.text: Therefore my heart, Moab, will hum like flutes; my heart will hum like a flute for Kiradas’s people. Therefore what he acquired perished from a person.
verses.display_text: Therefore my heart, Moab, will hum like flutes; my heart will hum like a flute for Kiradas’s people. Therefore what he acquired perished from a person.

verses.text: They will shave every head in every place; every beard will be shaved, all hands will beat themselves, and on every waist is sackcloth.
verses.display_text: They will shave every head in every place; every beard will be shaved, all hands will beat themselves, and on every waist is sackcloth.

verses.text: And on all Moab’s rooftops and in her squares—for I shattered Moab, says the Lord, like a vessel for which there is no use.
verses.display_text: And on all Moab’s rooftops and in her squares—for I shattered Moab, says the Lord, like a vessel for which there is no use.

verses.text: How he has changed! How Moab turned his back! He was ashamed, and Moab became a laughingstock and an object of resentment to all around her.
verses.display_text: How he has changed! How Moab turned his back! He was ashamed, and Moab became a laughingstock and an object of resentment to all around her.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord:
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord:

verses.text: Akkarioth was taken and the fortifications seized.
verses.display_text: Akkarioth was taken and the fortifications seized.

verses.text: Moab will perish from being a multitude, for he magnified himself against the Lord.
verses.display_text: Moab will perish from being a multitude, for he magnified himself against the Lord.

verses.text: Trap, fear, and pit are upon you, resident Moab.
verses.display_text: Trap, fear, and pit are upon you, resident Moab.

verses.text: One who flees from fear will fall into the pit, and one who climbs from the pit will be caught in the trap, for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of her visitation.
verses.display_text: One who flees from fear will fall into the pit, and one who climbs from the pit will be caught in the trap, for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of her visitation.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: Take this cup of unmixed wine from My hand, and give it to all the nations to whom I send you to drink,
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: Take this cup of unmixed wine from My hand, and give it to all the nations to whom I send you to drink,

verses.text: and they will drink, vomit, and go mad before the sword I am sending among them.
verses.display_text: and they will drink, vomit, and go mad before the sword I am sending among them.

verses.text: And I took the cup from the Lord’s hand and gave it to the nations to whom the Lord sent me to drink:
verses.display_text: And I took the cup from the Lord’s hand and gave it to the nations to whom the Lord sent me to drink:

verses.text: Jerusalem, Judah’s cities, Judah’s kings, and its rulers, to make them a desolation, an untrodden place, and a hissing;
