verses.text: because behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will return the deportees of My people Israel and Judah, said the Lord. I will return them to the land I gave their fathers, and they will rule over it.
verses.display_text: because behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will return the deportees of My people Israel and Judah, said the Lord. I will return them to the land I gave their fathers, and they will rule over it.

verses.text: And these are the words the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah:
verses.display_text: And these are the words the Lord spoke concerning Israel and Judah:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: You will hear a sound of fear—fear, and there is no peace.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: You will hear a sound of fear—fear, and there is no peace.

verses.text: Ask and see whether a male gave birth, and about fear in which they will hold loins and salvation. For I have seen every person with his hands upon his loins; faces turned toward jaundice—
verses.display_text: Ask and see whether a male gave birth, and about fear in which they will hold loins and salvation. For I have seen every person with his hands upon his loins; faces turned toward jaundice—

verses.text: so it became. For that day is great, and there is none like it; it is a narrow time for Jacob, and he will be saved from it.
verses.display_text: so it became. For that day is great, and there is none like it; it is a narrow time for Jacob, and he will be saved from it.

verses.text: On that day, said the Lord, I will smash the yoke from their neck and tear apart their bonds, and they will no longer work for foreigners.
verses.display_text: On that day, said the Lord, I will smash the yoke from their neck and tear apart their bonds, and they will no longer work for foreigners.

verses.text: And they will work for the Lord their God, and I will raise up David their king for them.
verses.display_text: And they will work for the Lord their God, and I will raise up David their king for them.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: I raised up a fracture; your wound is painful.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: I raised up a fracture; your wound is painful.

verses.text: There is no one judging your case; you were treated into pain. There is no benefit for you.
verses.display_text: There is no one judging your case; you were treated into pain. There is no benefit for you.

verses.text: All your friends forgot you; they will certainly not inquire. For I struck you with an enemy’s blow, a firm discipline; upon all your injustice your sins multiplied.
verses.display_text: All your friends forgot you; they will certainly not inquire. For I struck you with an enemy’s blow, a firm discipline; upon all your injustice your sins multiplied.

verses.text: Therefore all who eat you will be eaten; as for all your enemies, they will eat all their flesh. Upon the multitude of your injustices your sins multiplied; they did these things to you. Those plundering you will become plunder, and I will give all who despoil you as spoil.
verses.display_text: Therefore all who eat you will be eaten; as for all your enemies, they will eat all their flesh. Upon the multitude of your injustices your sins multiplied; they did these things to you. Those plundering you will become plunder, and I will give all who despoil you as spoil.

verses.text: Because I will bring up your cure and heal you from a painful wound, says the Lord, because you were called Scattered: She is your prey, because no one seeks her.
verses.display_text: Because I will bring up your cure and heal you from a painful wound, says the Lord, because you were called Scattered: She is your prey, because no one seeks her.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Behold, I will return Jacob’s deportees and have mercy on his captivity. A city will be built upon its height, and the sanctuary will sit according to its judgment.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Behold, I will return Jacob’s deportees and have mercy on his captivity. A city will be built upon its height, and the sanctuary will sit according to its judgment.

verses.text: And singers and the sound of people playing will come out from them. I will increase them, and they will certainly not be diminished.
verses.display_text: And singers and the sound of people playing will come out from them. I will increase them, and they will certainly not be diminished.

verses.text: And their sons will enter as formerly, and their testimonies will be set upright before Me. I will visit those afflicting them.
verses.display_text: And their sons will enter as formerly, and their testimonies will be set upright before Me. I will visit those afflicting them.

verses.text: And stronger ones of his will be over them, and his ruler will come out from him. I will gather them, and they will return to Me. For who is this who gave his heart to return to Me? says the Lord.
verses.display_text: And stronger ones of his will be over them, and his ruler will come out from him. I will gather them, and they will return to Me. For who is this who gave his heart to return to Me? says the Lord.

verses.text: Because the Lord’s anger went out furious; swirling anger went out and will come upon the ungodly.
verses.display_text: Because the Lord’s anger went out furious; swirling anger went out and will come upon the ungodly.

verses.text: The anger of the Lord’s fury will certainly not turn back until He acts and establishes His heart’s undertaking. At the end of the days you will know these things.
verses.display_text: The anger of the Lord’s fury will certainly not turn back until He acts and establishes His heart’s undertaking. At the end of the days you will know these things.

verses.text: At that time, said the Lord, I will be God to Israel’s family, and they will be My people.
verses.display_text: At that time, said the Lord, I will be God to Israel’s family, and they will be My people.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: I found warmth in the wilderness among those who perished by the sword. Go, and do not destroy Israel.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: I found warmth in the wilderness among those who perished by the sword. Go, and do not destroy Israel.

verses.text: The Lord appeared to him from afar: I loved you with an eternal love; therefore I drew you into compassion.
verses.display_text: The Lord appeared to him from afar: I loved you with an eternal love; therefore I drew you into compassion.

verses.text: Again I will build you, and you will be built, virgin Israel. Again you will take your tambourine and go out with a gathering of people playing.
verses.display_text: Again I will build you, and you will be built, virgin Israel. Again you will take your tambourine and go out with a gathering of people playing.

verses.text: Again plant vineyards on Samaria’s mountains; plant and praise.
verses.display_text: Again plant vineyards on Samaria’s mountains; plant and praise.

verses.text: Because there is a day of calling by those making their defense in Ephraim’s mountains: Rise and go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.
verses.display_text: Because there is a day of calling by those making their defense in Ephraim’s mountains: Rise and go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.

verses.text: Because thus said the Lord to Jacob: Rejoice and neigh aloud toward the head of the nations; make it heard and praise. Say: The Lord saved His people, Israel’s remnant!
verses.display_text: Because thus said the Lord to Jacob: Rejoice and neigh aloud toward the head of the nations; make it heard and praise. Say: The Lord saved His people, Israel’s remnant!

verses.text: Behold, I am bringing them from the north and will gather them from the earth’s farthest end at the Passover festival. You will bear a great crowd, and they will return here.
verses.display_text: Behold, I am bringing them from the north and will gather them from the earth’s farthest end at the Passover festival. You will bear a great crowd, and they will return here.

verses.text: They went out with weeping, and with encouragement I will bring them up, lodging them beside water channels on a straight road where they will certainly not wander, because I became Israel’s father, and Ephraim is My firstborn.
verses.display_text: They went out with weeping, and with encouragement I will bring them up, lodging them beside water channels on a straight road where they will certainly not wander, because I became Israel’s father, and Ephraim is My firstborn.

verses.text: Hear the Lord’s word, nations, and announce it to the farther islands. Say: He who winnowed Israel will gather him and guard him like one tending his flock.
verses.display_text: Hear the Lord’s word, nations, and announce it to the farther islands. Say: He who winnowed Israel will gather him and guard him like one tending his flock.

verses.text: Because the Lord ransomed Jacob and rescued him from the hand of those stronger than he.
verses.display_text: Because the Lord ransomed Jacob and rescued him from the hand of those stronger than he.

verses.text: They will come and rejoice on Mount Zion; they will come for the Lord’s good things, to a land of grain, wine, fruits, livestock, and sheep. Their life will be like a fruitful tree, and they will hunger no more.
verses.display_text: They will come and rejoice on Mount Zion; they will come for the Lord’s good things, to a land of grain, wine, fruits, livestock, and sheep. Their life will be like a fruitful tree, and they will hunger no more.

verses.text: Then virgins will rejoice in a gathering of young men, and elders will rejoice. I will turn their mourning into gladness and make them joyful.
verses.display_text: Then virgins will rejoice in a gathering of young men, and elders will rejoice. I will turn their mourning into gladness and make them joyful.

verses.text: I will magnify and fill the priests’ souls to abundance, the sons of Levi, and My people will be filled with My good things.
verses.display_text: I will magnify and fill the priests’ souls to abundance, the sons of Levi, and My people will be filled with My good things.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping, and wailing. Rachel, weeping aloud, would not stop over her sons, because they are no more.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping, and wailing. Rachel, weeping aloud, would not stop over her sons, because they are no more.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Let your voice cease from weeping and your eyes from your tears, because your works have a reward, and they will return from enemies’ land,
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Let your voice cease from weeping and your eyes from your tears, because your works have a reward, and they will return from enemies’ land,

verses.text: a lasting stay for your children.
verses.display_text: a lasting stay for your children.

verses.text: I surely heard Ephraim wailing: Thou didst discipline me, and I was disciplined; like a calf I was not taught. Turn me back, and I will return, because Thou art the Lord my God.
verses.display_text: I surely heard Ephraim wailing: Thou didst discipline me, and I was disciplined; like a calf I was not taught. Turn me back, and I will return, because Thou art the Lord my God.

verses.text: Because after my captivity I repented, and after I came to know, I groaned over days of shame and showed Thee that I received reproach from my youth.
verses.display_text: Because after my captivity I repented, and after I came to know, I groaned over days of shame and showed Thee that I received reproach from my youth.

verses.text: Ephraim is a beloved son to Me, a child taking delight, because My words are in him; I will surely remember him. Therefore I hastened toward him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Ephraim is a beloved son to Me, a child taking delight, because My words are in him; I will surely remember him. Therefore I hastened toward him; I will surely have mercy on him, says the Lord.

verses.text: Stand firm, Zion; carry out punishment; set your heart upon the shoulders. Turn back along the road you traveled, virgin Israel; turn back to your cities in mourning.
verses.display_text: Stand firm, Zion; carry out punishment; set your heart upon the shoulders. Turn back along the road you traveled, virgin Israel; turn back to your cities in mourning.

verses.text: How long will you turn away, dishonored daughter? Because the Lord created salvation for a new planting; people will go about in salvation.
verses.display_text: How long will you turn away, dishonored daughter? Because the Lord created salvation for a new planting; people will go about in salvation.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: They will again say this word in Judah’s land and its cities when I return its captivity: Blessed is the Lord over the righteous mountain, His holy mountain,
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: They will again say this word in Judah’s land and its cities when I return its captivity: Blessed is the Lord over the righteous mountain, His holy mountain,

verses.text: and those dwelling in Judah’s cities and all its land together with a farmer; and he will be lifted up with a flock.
verses.display_text: and those dwelling in Judah’s cities and all its land together with a farmer; and he will be lifted up with a flock.

verses.text: Because I filled every thirsty soul to abundance and filled every hungry soul.
verses.display_text: Because I filled every thirsty soul to abundance and filled every hungry soul.

verses.text: Therefore I awoke and saw, and my sleep became sweet to me.
verses.display_text: Therefore I awoke and saw, and my sleep became sweet to me.

verses.text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will sow Israel and Judah with human seed and livestock seed.
verses.display_text: Therefore behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will sow Israel and Judah with human seed and livestock seed.

verses.text: And just as I watched over them to tear down and harm, so I will watch over them to build and plant, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: And just as I watched over them to tear down and harm, so I will watch over them to build and plant, says the Lord.

verses.text: In those days they will certainly not say: The fathers ate an unripe grape, and the children’s teeth were set on edge.
verses.display_text: In those days they will certainly not say: The fathers ate an unripe grape, and the children’s teeth were set on edge.

verses.text: Instead, each will die in his own sin, and the one eating the unripe grape will have his own teeth set on edge.
verses.display_text: Instead, each will die in his own sin, and the one eating the unripe grape will have his own teeth set on edge.

verses.text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,
verses.display_text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah,

verses.text: not according to the covenant I made with their fathers on the day I took their hand to bring them out of Egypt’s land, because they did not remain in My covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: not according to the covenant I made with their fathers on the day I took their hand to bring them out of Egypt’s land, because they did not remain in My covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.

verses.text: Because this is the covenant I will make with Israel’s house after those days, says the Lord: I will surely put My laws into their understanding and write them upon their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be My people.
verses.display_text: Because this is the covenant I will make with Israel’s house after those days, says the Lord: I will surely put My laws into their understanding and write them upon their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be My people.

verses.text: And they will certainly not teach each his fellow citizen or his brother, saying, Know the Lord, because they will all know Me, from their least to their greatest. I will be merciful toward their injustices and certainly remember their sins no more.
verses.display_text: And they will certainly not teach each his fellow citizen or his brother, saying, Know the Lord, because they will all know Me, from their least to their greatest. I will be merciful toward their injustices and certainly remember their sins no more.

verses.text: If the heaven is raised to the height, says the Lord, and the earth’s ground lowered beneath, even then I do not reject Israel’s family, says the Lord, for all they did.
verses.display_text: If the heaven is raised to the height, says the Lord, and the earth’s ground lowered beneath, even then I do not reject Israel’s family, says the Lord, for all they did.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, who gave the sun for daylight, moon and stars for night light, and a cry in the sea so its waves boomed—the Lord Almighty is His name:
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, who gave the sun for daylight, moon and stars for night light, and a cry in the sea so its waves boomed—the Lord Almighty is His name:

verses.text: If these laws cease from before Me, says the Lord, then Israel’s family will cease to be a nation before Me for all days.
verses.display_text: If these laws cease from before Me, says the Lord, then Israel’s family will cease to be a nation before Me for all days.

verses.text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and a city will be built for the Lord from Hanamel’s tower to the Corner Gate.
verses.display_text: Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and a city will be built for the Lord from Hanamel’s tower to the Corner Gate.

verses.text: And its measurement will go out opposite them as far as Gareb’s hills, and it will be enclosed all around with chosen stones.
verses.display_text: And its measurement will go out opposite them as far as Gareb’s hills, and it will be enclosed all around with chosen stones.

verses.text: And all Asaremoth as far as the Kidron wadi, to the corner of the eastern Horse Gate, will be a sanctuary for the Lord. It will certainly never disappear or be torn down for ever.
verses.display_text: And all Asaremoth as far as the Kidron wadi, to the corner of the eastern Horse Gate, will be a sanctuary for the Lord. It will certainly never disappear or be torn down for ever.

verses.text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah in King Zedekiah’s tenth year, which was the eighteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.
verses.display_text: The word that came from the Lord to Jeremiah in King Zedekiah’s tenth year, which was the eighteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon.

verses.text: The king of Babylon’s force had built siegeworks against Jerusalem, and Jeremiah was kept in the prison court at the king’s house.
verses.display_text: The king of Babylon’s force had built siegeworks against Jerusalem, and Jeremiah was kept in the prison court at the king’s house.

verses.text: King Zedekiah had shut him in there, saying, Why do you prophesy, saying, Thus said the Lord: I am handing this city over to Babylon’s king, and he will take it?
verses.display_text: King Zedekiah had shut him in there, saying, Why do you prophesy, saying, Thus said the Lord: I am handing this city over to Babylon’s king, and he will take it?

verses.text: Zedekiah will certainly not be saved from the Chaldeans’ hand, but will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king. His mouth will speak to his mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah will certainly not be saved from the Chaldeans’ hand, but will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king. His mouth will speak to his mouth, and his eyes will see his eyes.

verses.text: Zedekiah will enter Babylon and remain there.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah will enter Babylon and remain there.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:

verses.text: Hanamel son of Shallum, your father’s brother, is coming to you, saying, Acquire my field at Anathoth for yourself, because you have the right to receive it as a possession.
verses.display_text: Hanamel son of Shallum, your father’s brother, is coming to you, saying, Acquire my field at Anathoth for yourself, because you have the right to receive it as a possession.

verses.text: Hanamel son of Shallum, my father’s brother, came to me in the prison court and said, Acquire my field in Benjamin’s land at Anathoth, because you have the right to acquire it, and you are the elder. Then I knew that this was the Lord’s word.
verses.display_text: Hanamel son of Shallum, my father’s brother, came to me in the prison court and said, Acquire my field in Benjamin’s land at Anathoth, because you have the right to acquire it, and you are the elder. Then I knew that this was the Lord’s word.

verses.text: I acquired the field of Hanamel, my father’s brother’s son, and weighed out to him seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.display_text: I acquired the field of Hanamel, my father’s brother’s son, and weighed out to him seventeen shekels of silver.

verses.text: I wrote a document, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the silver on a balance.
verses.display_text: I wrote a document, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the silver on a balance.

verses.text: I took the purchase document, the sealed one and the one that had been read.
verses.display_text: I took the purchase document, the sealed one and the one that had been read.

verses.text: I gave it to Baruch son of Neriah son of Maaseiah, before Hanamel my father’s brother’s son, before those standing there and writing in the purchase document, and before the Judeans in the prison court.
verses.display_text: I gave it to Baruch son of Neriah son of Maaseiah, before Hanamel my father’s brother’s son, before those standing there and writing in the purchase document, and before the Judeans in the prison court.

verses.text: Before their eyes I instructed Baruch:
verses.display_text: Before their eyes I instructed Baruch:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord Almighty: Take this purchase document and the document that has been read, and put it in an earthenware vessel so that it may last many days.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord Almighty: Take this purchase document and the document that has been read, and put it in an earthenware vessel so that it may last many days.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: Fields, houses, and vineyards will again be acquired in this land.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: Fields, houses, and vineyards will again be acquired in this land.

verses.text: After giving the purchase document to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord:
verses.display_text: After giving the purchase document to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord:

verses.text: O Lord, Thou madest heaven and earth by Thy great strength and Thy high, uplifted arm. Nothing can be hidden from Thee.
verses.display_text: O Lord, Thou madest heaven and earth by Thy great strength and Thy high, uplifted arm. Nothing can be hidden from Thee.

verses.text: Thou showest mercy to thousands and repayest fathers’ sins into their children’s laps after them, the great and strong God,
verses.display_text: Thou showest mercy to thousands and repayest fathers’ sins into their children’s laps after them, the great and strong God,

verses.text: Lord of great counsel and powerful in works, the great God, the Almighty and renowned Lord. Thine eyes are upon the ways of human beings, to give each according to his way.
verses.display_text: Lord of great counsel and powerful in works, the great God, the Almighty and renowned Lord. Thine eyes are upon the ways of human beings, to give each according to his way.

verses.text: Thou didst perform signs and wonders in Egypt down to this day, in Israel and among earthborn people, and madest a name for Thyself as it is this day.
verses.display_text: Thou didst perform signs and wonders in Egypt down to this day, in Israel and among earthborn people, and madest a name for Thyself as it is this day.

verses.text: Thou broughtest Thy people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a mighty hand, a high arm, and great sights.
verses.display_text: Thou broughtest Thy people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a mighty hand, a high arm, and great sights.

verses.text: Thou gavest them this land, which Thou hadst sworn to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.display_text: Thou gavest them this land, which Thou hadst sworn to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.text: They entered and received it, but did not obey Thy voice or walk in Thine ordinances. They did none of all that Thou didst command them, and Thou didst cause all these calamities to befall them.
verses.display_text: They entered and received it, but did not obey Thy voice or walk in Thine ordinances. They did none of all that Thou didst command them, and Thou didst cause all these calamities to befall them.

verses.text: A multitude has reached this city to seize it. The city was handed over to the Chaldeans fighting it because of sword and famine. As Thou spakest, so it happened.
verses.display_text: A multitude has reached this city to seize it. The city was handed over to the Chaldeans fighting it because of sword and famine. As Thou spakest, so it happened.

verses.text: Yet Thou sayest to me, Acquire a field with silver. And I wrote a document, sealed it, and called witnesses—even though the city was handed over to the Chaldeans.
verses.display_text: Yet Thou sayest to me, Acquire a field with silver. And I wrote a document, sealed it, and called witnesses—even though the city was handed over to the Chaldeans.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me:

verses.text: I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Can anything be hidden from Me?
verses.display_text: I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Can anything be hidden from Me?

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: This city will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king, and he will take it.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: This city will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king, and he will take it.

verses.text: The Chaldeans fighting this city will come and burn this city with fire. They will burn down the houses on whose roofs they burned incense to Baal and poured libations to other gods to provoke Me bitterly.
verses.display_text: The Chaldeans fighting this city will come and burn this city with fire. They will burn down the houses on whose roofs they burned incense to Baal and poured libations to other gods to provoke Me bitterly.

verses.text: The children of Israel and Judah alone were doing evil in My sight from their youth.
verses.display_text: The children of Israel and Judah alone were doing evil in My sight from their youth.

verses.text: This city has aroused My anger and wrath from the day they built it until this day, so that I would remove it from My presence,
verses.display_text: This city has aroused My anger and wrath from the day they built it until this day, so that I would remove it from My presence,

verses.text: because of all the wicked deeds the children of Israel and Judah committed to embitter Me—they and their kings, their rulers, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants.
verses.display_text: because of all the wicked deeds the children of Israel and Judah committed to embitter Me—they and their kings, their rulers, their priests, their prophets, the men of Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants.

verses.text: They turned their backs to Me, not their faces. I taught them from early morning and kept teaching, but they did not listen and take hold of discipline.
verses.display_text: They turned their backs to Me, not their faces. I taught them from early morning and kept teaching, but they did not listen and take hold of discipline.

verses.text: They set their pollutions in the house over which My name is invoked, amid their impurities.
verses.display_text: They set their pollutions in the house over which My name is invoked, amid their impurities.

verses.text: They built the altars to Baal in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to offer their sons and daughters to Molech the king. I had not instructed them, nor had it entered My heart, to do this abomination and cause Judah to sin.
verses.display_text: They built the altars to Baal in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, to offer their sons and daughters to Molech the king. I had not instructed them, nor had it entered My heart, to do this abomination and cause Judah to sin.

verses.text: And now, thus said the Lord, Israel’s God, concerning the city of which you say, It will be handed over to Babylon’s king by sword, famine, and a sent affliction:
verses.display_text: And now, thus said the Lord, Israel’s God, concerning the city of which you say, It will be handed over to Babylon’s king by sword, famine, and a sent affliction:

verses.text: I am gathering them from all the land where I scattered them in My anger, wrath, and great indignation. I will bring them back to this place and settle them in confidence.
verses.display_text: I am gathering them from all the land where I scattered them in My anger, wrath, and great indignation. I will bring them back to this place and settle them in confidence.

verses.text: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.display_text: They will be My people, and I will be their God.

verses.text: I will give them another way and another heart, to fear Me always, for their good and their children’s good after them.
verses.display_text: I will give them another way and another heart, to fear Me always, for their good and their children’s good after them.

verses.text: I will establish an eternal covenant with them, which I will certainly not turn back from behind them. I will put My fear in their heart so that they do not depart from Me.
verses.display_text: I will establish an eternal covenant with them, which I will certainly not turn back from behind them. I will put My fear in their heart so that they do not depart from Me.

verses.text: I will attend to them to do them good and will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all heart and all soul.
verses.display_text: I will attend to them to do them good and will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all heart and all soul.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: Just as I brought all these great calamities upon this people, so I will bring upon them all the good things I spoke concerning them.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: Just as I brought all these great calamities upon this people, so I will bring upon them all the good things I spoke concerning them.

verses.text: Fields will again be acquired in the land of which you say, It is untrodden by people and animals, and they were handed over to the Chaldeans.
verses.display_text: Fields will again be acquired in the land of which you say, It is untrodden by people and animals, and they were handed over to the Chaldeans.

verses.text: They will acquire fields with silver, and you will write a document, seal it, and call witnesses in Benjamin’s land, around Jerusalem, in Judah’s cities, the hill-country cities, the cities of the Shephelah, and the cities of the Negeb, because I will bring back their exiles.
verses.display_text: They will acquire fields with silver, and you will write a document, seal it, and call witnesses in Benjamin’s land, around Jerusalem, in Judah’s cities, the hill-country cities, the cities of the Shephelah, and the cities of the Negeb, because I will bring back their exiles.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still bound in the prison court:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still bound in the prison court:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, who makes the earth and forms it to set it upright—the Lord is His name:
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, who makes the earth and forms it to set it upright—the Lord is His name:

verses.text: Cry out to Me and I will answer you. I will announce to you great, mighty things you have not known.
verses.display_text: Cry out to Me and I will answer you. I will announce to you great, mighty things you have not known.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord, Israel’s God, about this city’s houses and the houses of Judah’s king, torn down for siegeworks and defenses,
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord, Israel’s God, about this city’s houses and the houses of Judah’s king, torn down for siegeworks and defenses,

verses.text: to fight the Chaldeans and fill the city with the dead bodies of people I struck in My anger and wrath. I turned My face from them because of all their wicked deeds.
verses.display_text: to fight the Chaldeans and fill the city with the dead bodies of people I struck in My anger and wrath. I turned My face from them because of all their wicked deeds.

verses.text: I am bringing her the closing of wounds and a remedy. I will reveal to them that I listen, heal her, and make peace and faithfulness for them.
verses.display_text: I am bringing her the closing of wounds and a remedy. I will reveal to them that I listen, heal her, and make peace and faithfulness for them.

verses.text: I will bring back Judah’s exiles and Israel’s exiles and build them as before.
verses.display_text: I will bring back Judah’s exiles and Israel’s exiles and build them as before.

verses.text: I will cleanse them from all the injustices by which they sinned against Me. I will certainly not remember the sins they committed against Me when they departed from Me.
verses.display_text: I will cleanse them from all the injustices by which they sinned against Me. I will certainly not remember the sins they committed against Me when they departed from Me.

verses.text: It will be for joy, praise, and greatness to all the people of the earth. They will hear all the good things I will do, and they will fear and be distressed over all the good and peace I will bring them.
verses.display_text: It will be for joy, praise, and greatness to all the people of the earth. They will hear all the good things I will do, and they will fear and be distressed over all the good and peace I will bring them.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Again in this place, which you call deserted of people and animals, in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, desolate because there are no people or animals, there will be heard
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Again in this place, which you call deserted of people and animals, in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, desolate because there are no people or animals, there will be heard

verses.text: the sound of joy and rejoicing, the bridegroom’s voice and the bride’s voice, the voices of those saying, Give thanks to the Lord Almighty, for the Lord is good; His mercy is for ever. They will bring gifts into the Lord’s house, for I will bring back all the exiles of that land as before, said the Lord.
verses.display_text: the sound of joy and rejoicing, the bridegroom’s voice and the bride’s voice, the voices of those saying, Give thanks to the Lord Almighty, for the Lord is good; His mercy is for ever. They will bring gifts into the Lord’s house, for I will bring back all the exiles of that land as before, said the Lord.

verses.text: Thus said the Lord of forces: Again in this place, deserted because there are no people or animals, and in all its cities, there will be lodgings for shepherds settling sheep down.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord of forces: Again in this place, deserted because there are no people or animals, and in all its cities, there will be lodgings for shepherds settling sheep down.

verses.text: In the hill-country cities, the cities of the Shephelah, the cities of the Negeb, in Benjamin’s land, in the places around Jerusalem, and in Judah’s cities, sheep will again pass under the hand of the one counting, said the Lord.
verses.display_text: In the hill-country cities, the cities of the Shephelah, the cities of the Negeb, in Benjamin’s land, in the places around Jerusalem, and in Judah’s cities, sheep will again pass under the hand of the one counting, said the Lord.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord while Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his whole army, and all the land under his rule were fighting Jerusalem and all Judah’s cities:
verses.display_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord while Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his whole army, and all the land under his rule were fighting Jerusalem and all Judah’s cities:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, Thus said the Lord: This city will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king. He will seize it and burn it with fire.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, Thus said the Lord: This city will certainly be handed over to Babylon’s king. He will seize it and burn it with fire.

verses.text: You will certainly not be saved from his hand. You will certainly be captured and handed over to him. Your eyes will see his eyes, and his mouth will speak with your mouth. You will enter Babylon.
verses.display_text: You will certainly not be saved from his hand. You will certainly be captured and handed over to him. Your eyes will see his eyes, and his mouth will speak with your mouth. You will enter Babylon.

verses.text: But hear the Lord’s word, Zedekiah king of Judah. Thus says the Lord:
verses.display_text: But hear the Lord’s word, Zedekiah king of Judah. Thus says the Lord:

verses.text: You will die in peace. As they wept for your fathers who reigned before you, they will weep for you and lament you, O lord! For I have spoken the word, said the Lord.
verses.display_text: You will die in peace. As they wept for your fathers who reigned before you, they will weep for you and lament you, O lord! For I have spoken the word, said the Lord.

verses.text: Jeremiah spoke all these words to King Zedekiah in Jerusalem,
verses.display_text: Jeremiah spoke all these words to King Zedekiah in Jerusalem,

verses.text: while Babylon’s king’s force fought Jerusalem and Judah’s cities, Lachish and Azekah; these were the fortified cities left among Judah’s cities.
verses.display_text: while Babylon’s king’s force fought Jerusalem and Judah’s cities, Lachish and Azekah; these were the fortified cities left among Judah’s cities.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah concluded a covenant with the people to proclaim release:
verses.display_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord after King Zedekiah concluded a covenant with the people to proclaim release:

verses.text: each was to send his Hebrew male slave and his Hebrew female slave away free, so that a man from Judah would not be enslaved.
verses.display_text: each was to send his Hebrew male slave and his Hebrew female slave away free, so that a man from Judah would not be enslaved.

verses.text: All the magnates and all the people who had entered the covenant to send away their male and female slaves turned back,
verses.display_text: All the magnates and all the people who had entered the covenant to send away their male and female slaves turned back,

verses.text: and thrust them into the position of male and female slaves.
verses.display_text: and thrust them into the position of male and female slaves.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: I established a covenant with your fathers on the day I rescued them from Egypt, from the house of slavery, saying:
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: I established a covenant with your fathers on the day I rescued them from Egypt, from the house of slavery, saying:

verses.text: When six years are complete, you must send away your Hebrew brother who is sold to you. He will work for you six years, and you must send him away free. But they did not obey Me or incline their ears.
verses.display_text: When six years are complete, you must send away your Hebrew brother who is sold to you. He will work for you six years, and you must send him away free. But they did not obey Me or incline their ears.

verses.text: Today they turned to do what was right before My eyes, each proclaiming his neighbor’s release. They concluded a covenant before Me in the house over which My name is invoked.
verses.display_text: Today they turned to do what was right before My eyes, each proclaiming his neighbor’s release. They concluded a covenant before Me in the house over which My name is invoked.

verses.text: Then you reversed yourselves and profaned My name by bringing back your male and female slaves, whom you had sent away free in their own persons, to be your slaves.
verses.display_text: Then you reversed yourselves and profaned My name by bringing back your male and female slaves, whom you had sent away free in their own persons, to be your slaves.

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord: You did not obey Me by proclaiming release, each to his neighbor. So I proclaim release for you to sword, death, and famine! I will give you over to scattering among all the earth’s kingdoms.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord: You did not obey Me by proclaiming release, each to his neighbor. So I proclaim release for you to sword, death, and famine! I will give you over to scattering among all the earth’s kingdoms.

verses.text: I will hand over the men who passed beyond My covenant, who did not uphold My covenant which they made before Me—the calf they made, to work for it—
verses.display_text: I will hand over the men who passed beyond My covenant, who did not uphold My covenant which they made before Me—the calf they made, to work for it—

verses.text: Judah’s rulers, the powerful men, the priests, and the people.
verses.display_text: Judah’s rulers, the powerful men, the priests, and the people.

verses.text: I will hand them over to their enemies, and their carcasses will become food for the birds of heaven and the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.display_text: I will hand them over to their enemies, and their carcasses will become food for the birds of heaven and the wild beasts of the earth.

verses.text: I will hand Zedekiah king of Judea and their rulers over to their enemies. And the force of Babylon’s king is for those running away from them.
verses.display_text: I will hand Zedekiah king of Judea and their rulers over to their enemies. And the force of Babylon’s king is for those running away from them.

verses.text: I am giving orders, says the Lord, and will bring them back to this land. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire, along with Judah’s cities; I will make them deserted of inhabitants.
verses.display_text: I am giving orders, says the Lord, and will bring them back to this land. They will fight against it, take it, and burn it with fire, along with Judah’s cities; I will make them deserted of inhabitants.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim king of Judah:
verses.display_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim king of Judah:

verses.text: Go to the house of the Rechabites. Bring them into the Lord’s house, into one of the courts, and give them wine to drink.
verses.display_text: Go to the house of the Rechabites. Bring them into the Lord’s house, into one of the courts, and give them wine to drink.

verses.text: I brought out Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah son of Habazziniah, his brothers, his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.
verses.display_text: I brought out Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah son of Habazziniah, his brothers, his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.

verses.text: I brought them into the Lord’s house, into the chamber of the sons of Hananiah son of Gedaliah, the man of God. It is near the house of the rulers above the house of Maaseiah son of Shallum, who guards the court.
verses.display_text: I brought them into the Lord’s house, into the chamber of the sons of Hananiah son of Gedaliah, the man of God. It is near the house of the rulers above the house of Maaseiah son of Shallum, who guards the court.

verses.text: I set before them an earthenware jar of wine and cups, and said, Drink wine.
verses.display_text: I set before them an earthenware jar of wine and cups, and said, Drink wine.

verses.text: They said, We certainly will not drink wine, because Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, commanded us: Neither you nor your sons must ever drink wine.
verses.display_text: They said, We certainly will not drink wine, because Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, commanded us: Neither you nor your sons must ever drink wine.

verses.text: You must not build a house or sow seed, and you must not have a vineyard. You must live in tents all your days, so that you may live many days on the land where you spend your time.
verses.display_text: You must not build a house or sow seed, and you must not have a vineyard. You must live in tents all your days, so that you may live many days on the land where you spend your time.

verses.text: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab our father by not drinking wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters,
verses.display_text: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab our father by not drinking wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters,

verses.text: and by not building houses to live there. We have had no vineyard, field, or sown crop.
verses.display_text: and by not building houses to live there. We have had no vineyard, field, or sown crop.

verses.text: We lived in tents, obeying and doing everything Jonadab our father commanded us.
verses.display_text: We lived in tents, obeying and doing everything Jonadab our father commanded us.

verses.text: When Nebuchadnezzar invaded the land, we said, Come in, let us enter Jerusalem to escape the Chaldean force and the Assyrian force. So we were living there.
verses.display_text: When Nebuchadnezzar invaded the land, we said, Come in, let us enter Jerusalem to escape the Chaldean force and the Assyrian force. So we were living there.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me:

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Go and say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants, Will you really not accept discipline and hear My words?
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Go and say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants, Will you really not accept discipline and hear My words?

verses.text: The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab upheld the word he commanded his children, not to drink wine, and they drank none. Yet I spoke to you from early morning and kept speaking, and you did not listen.
verses.display_text: The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab upheld the word he commanded his children, not to drink wine, and they drank none. Yet I spoke to you from early morning and kept speaking, and you did not listen.

verses.text: I sent you My servants the prophets, saying, Each of you, turn from his evil way and improve your practices. Do not follow other gods to serve them, and you will live on the land I gave you and your fathers. But you did not incline your ears or listen.
verses.display_text: I sent you My servants the prophets, saying, Each of you, turn from his evil way and improve your practices. Do not follow other gods to serve them, and you will live on the land I gave you and your fathers. But you did not incline your ears or listen.

verses.text: The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab upheld their father’s command, but this people did not obey Me.
verses.display_text: The sons of Jonadab son of Rechab upheld their father’s command, but this people did not obey Me.

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord: I am bringing upon Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants all the calamities I pronounced against them.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord: I am bringing upon Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants all the calamities I pronounced against them.

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord: Because the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab obeyed their father’s command, doing as their father commanded them,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord: Because the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab obeyed their father’s command, doing as their father commanded them,

verses.text: there will certainly never fail a man from the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab standing before Me all the earth’s days.
verses.display_text: there will certainly never fail a man from the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab standing before Me all the earth’s days.

verses.text: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, the Lord’s word came to me:
verses.display_text: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, the Lord’s word came to me:

verses.text: Take a writing roll and write on it all the words I have delivered to you as oracles concerning Jerusalem, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah king of Judah until today.
verses.display_text: Take a writing roll and write on it all the words I have delivered to you as oracles concerning Jerusalem, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah king of Judah until today.

verses.text: Perhaps Judah’s house will hear all the calamities I intend to bring upon them, so that they turn from their evil way and I may be merciful toward their injustices and sins.
verses.display_text: Perhaps Judah’s house will hear all the calamities I intend to bring upon them, so that they turn from their evil way and I may be merciful toward their injustices and sins.

verses.text: Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and he wrote on a writing roll, from Jeremiah’s mouth, all the Lord’s words which He had delivered to him as oracles.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and he wrote on a writing roll, from Jeremiah’s mouth, all the Lord’s words which He had delivered to him as oracles.

verses.text: Jeremiah instructed Baruch, I am under guard and cannot enter the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah instructed Baruch, I am under guard and cannot enter the Lord’s house.

verses.text: Read from this roll in the people’s hearing at the Lord’s house on a fast day, and read it to all Judah’s people coming from their city.
verses.display_text: Read from this roll in the people’s hearing at the Lord’s house on a fast day, and read it to all Judah’s people coming from their city.

verses.text: Perhaps their appeal for mercy will fall before the Lord, and they will turn from their evil way, for great are the Lord’s wrath and anger which He has pronounced against this people.
verses.display_text: Perhaps their appeal for mercy will fall before the Lord, and they will turn from their evil way, for great are the Lord’s wrath and anger which He has pronounced against this people.

verses.text: Baruch did everything Jeremiah instructed him, reading the Lord’s words from the document in the Lord’s house.
verses.display_text: Baruch did everything Jeremiah instructed him, reading the Lord’s words from the document in the Lord’s house.

verses.text: In King Jehoiakim’s eighth year, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and Judah’s house assembled for a fast before the Lord.
verses.display_text: In King Jehoiakim’s eighth year, in the ninth month, all the people in Jerusalem and Judah’s house assembled for a fast before the Lord.

verses.text: Baruch read Jeremiah’s words from the document in the Lord’s house, in the house of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court at the entrance of the New Gate of the Lord’s house, in all the people’s hearing.
verses.display_text: Baruch read Jeremiah’s words from the document in the Lord’s house, in the house of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the upper court at the entrance of the New Gate of the Lord’s house, in all the people’s hearing.

verses.text: Micaiah son of Gemariah son of Shaphan heard all the Lord’s words from the document.
verses.display_text: Micaiah son of Gemariah son of Shaphan heard all the Lord’s words from the document.

verses.text: He went down to the king’s house, to the scribe’s house. All the rulers were sitting there: Elishama the scribe, Delaiah son of Shelemiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the rulers.
verses.display_text: He went down to the king’s house, to the scribe’s house. All the rulers were sitting there: Elishama the scribe, Delaiah son of Shelemiah, Elnathan son of Achbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the rulers.

verses.text: Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard when Baruch read in the people’s hearing.
verses.display_text: Micaiah reported to them all the words he had heard when Baruch read in the people’s hearing.

verses.text: All the rulers sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah son of Shelemiah son of Cushi to Baruch son of Neriah, saying, Take in your hand the roll from which you are reading to the people, and come. Baruch took the roll and went down to them.
verses.display_text: All the rulers sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah son of Shelemiah son of Cushi to Baruch son of Neriah, saying, Take in your hand the roll from which you are reading to the people, and come. Baruch took the roll and went down to them.

verses.text: They said to him, Read it again to us. Baruch read it.
verses.display_text: They said to him, Read it again to us. Baruch read it.

verses.text: When they heard all the words, they consulted one another and said, Let us certainly report all these words to the king.
verses.display_text: When they heard all the words, they consulted one another and said, Let us certainly report all these words to the king.

verses.text: They asked Baruch, Where did all these words you wrote come from?
verses.display_text: They asked Baruch, Where did all these words you wrote come from?

verses.text: Baruch said, Jeremiah reported all these words to me from his mouth, and I wrote them in a document.
verses.display_text: Baruch said, Jeremiah reported all these words to me from his mouth, and I wrote them in a document.

verses.text: They said to Baruch, Go and hide, you and Jeremiah. Let no one know where you are.
verses.display_text: They said to Baruch, Go and hide, you and Jeremiah. Let no one know where you are.

verses.text: They entered the court to see the king, leaving the roll for safekeeping in Elishama’s house, and reported all the words to the king.
verses.display_text: They entered the court to see the king, leaving the roll for safekeeping in Elishama’s house, and reported all the words to the king.

verses.text: The king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll. He took it from Elishama’s house, and Jehudi read it to the king and all the rulers standing around him.
verses.display_text: The king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll. He took it from Elishama’s house, and Jehudi read it to the king and all the rulers standing around him.

verses.text: The king was sitting in a winter house, with a fire brazier before him.
verses.display_text: The king was sitting in a winter house, with a fire brazier before him.

verses.text: When Jehudi read three or four columns, the king cut them off with the scribe’s knife and threw them into the fire on the brazier, until the whole roll was consumed in the brazier’s fire.
verses.display_text: When Jehudi read three or four columns, the king cut them off with the scribe’s knife and threw them into the fire on the brazier, until the whole roll was consumed in the brazier’s fire.

verses.text: Neither the king nor his servants who heard all these words sought anything or tore their garments.
verses.display_text: Neither the king nor his servants who heard all these words sought anything or tore their garments.

verses.text: Elnathan, Gedaliah, and Gemariah advised the king not to burn the roll.
verses.display_text: Elnathan, Gedaliah, and Gemariah advised the king not to burn the roll.

verses.text: The king ordered Jerahmeel the king’s son and Seraiah son of Azriel to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah. But they were hidden.
verses.display_text: The king ordered Jerahmeel the king’s son and Seraiah son of Azriel to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah. But they were hidden.

verses.text: After the king burned the roll—all the words Baruch had written from Jeremiah’s mouth—the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: After the king burned the roll—all the words Baruch had written from Jeremiah’s mouth—the Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:

verses.text: Take another roll again and write all the words that were on the roll which King Jehoiakim burned.
verses.display_text: Take another roll again and write all the words that were on the roll which King Jehoiakim burned.

verses.text: Say, Thus said the Lord: You burned this roll, saying, Why did you write in it that Babylon’s king will certainly enter and destroy this land, and people and animals will cease from it?
verses.display_text: Say, Thus said the Lord: You burned this roll, saying, Why did you write in it that Babylon’s king will certainly enter and destroy this land, and people and animals will cease from it?

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one sitting on David’s throne. His carcass will be thrown out in the day’s heat and the night’s frost.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one sitting on David’s throne. His carcass will be thrown out in the day’s heat and the night’s frost.

verses.text: I will visit him, his family, and his servants, and bring upon them, Jerusalem’s inhabitants, and Judah’s land all the calamities I pronounced to them, but they did not listen.
verses.display_text: I will visit him, his family, and his servants, and bring upon them, Jerusalem’s inhabitants, and Judah’s land all the calamities I pronounced to them, but they did not listen.

verses.text: Baruch took another roll and wrote on it, from Jeremiah’s mouth, all the words of the document Jehoiakim burned. Still more words like these were added to it.
verses.display_text: Baruch took another roll and wrote on it, from Jeremiah’s mouth, all the words of the document Jehoiakim burned. Still more words like these were added to it.

verses.text: Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned in place of Jehoiakim; Nebuchadnezzar had made him king over Judah.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah son of Josiah reigned in place of Jehoiakim; Nebuchadnezzar had made him king over Judah.

verses.text: Neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land obeyed the Lord’s words, which He spoke through Jeremiah.
verses.display_text: Neither he nor his servants nor the people of the land obeyed the Lord’s words, which He spoke through Jeremiah.

verses.text: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Please pray for us to the Lord.
verses.display_text: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest to Jeremiah, saying, Please pray for us to the Lord.

verses.text: Jeremiah came and passed through the midst of the city; they had not put him in prison.
verses.display_text: Jeremiah came and passed through the midst of the city; they had not put him in prison.

verses.text: Pharaoh’s force came out of Egypt. The Chaldeans heard the report about them and withdrew from Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: Pharaoh’s force came out of Egypt. The Chaldeans heard the report about them and withdrew from Jerusalem.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: Tell Judah’s king, who sent to you to seek Me, Pharaoh’s force, which came out to help you, will return to Egypt’s land.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: Tell Judah’s king, who sent to you to seek Me, Pharaoh’s force, which came out to help you, will return to Egypt’s land.

verses.text: The Chaldeans themselves will return, fight this city, seize it, and burn it with fire.
verses.display_text: The Chaldeans themselves will return, fight this city, seize it, and burn it with fire.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: Do not suppose within yourselves, The Chaldeans will flee and leave us. They certainly will not leave.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: Do not suppose within yourselves, The Chaldeans will flee and leave us. They certainly will not leave.

verses.text: Even if you struck the whole Chaldean force fighting you and some were left pierced through, each in his place, these would rise and burn this city with fire.
verses.display_text: Even if you struck the whole Chaldean force fighting you and some were left pierced through, each in his place, these would rise and burn this city with fire.
