verses.text: All the people and all the foreigners who set their faces toward Egypt’s land to live there will perish by sword and famine. None of them will be saved from the calamities I am bringing upon them.
verses.display_text: All the people and all the foreigners who set their faces toward Egypt’s land to live there will perish by sword and famine. None of them will be saved from the calamities I am bringing upon them.

verses.text: For thus said the Lord: As My wrath dripped upon Jerusalem’s inhabitants, so My wrath will drip upon you when you enter Egypt. You will become an untrodden place, subject to others, a curse, and a reproach, and you certainly will never see this place again.
verses.display_text: For thus said the Lord: As My wrath dripped upon Jerusalem’s inhabitants, so My wrath will drip upon you when you enter Egypt. You will become an untrodden place, subject to others, a curse, and a reproach, and you certainly will never see this place again.

verses.text: These are the things the Lord spoke concerning you, Judah’s survivors: Do not enter Egypt. And now know for certain
verses.display_text: These are the things the Lord spoke concerning you, Judah’s survivors: Do not enter Egypt. And now know for certain

verses.text: that you acted wickedly in your souls when you sent me, saying, Pray for us to the Lord, and we will do everything the Lord tells you.
verses.display_text: that you acted wickedly in your souls when you sent me, saying, Pray for us to the Lord, and we will do everything the Lord tells you.

verses.text: And you did not obey the Lord’s voice, with which He sent me to you.
verses.display_text: And you did not obey the Lord’s voice, with which He sent me to you.

verses.text: And now you will perish by sword and famine in the place where you want to go and live.
verses.display_text: And now you will perish by sword and famine in the place where you want to go and live.

verses.text: When Jeremiah stopped speaking to the people all the Lord’s words, with which the Lord had sent him to them—all these words—
verses.display_text: When Jeremiah stopped speaking to the people all the Lord’s words, with which the Lord had sent him to them—all these words—

verses.text: Azariah son of Maaseiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the men who spoke said to Jeremiah, You are lying! The Lord did not send you to us to say, Do not enter Egypt to live there.
verses.display_text: Azariah son of Maaseiah, Johanan son of Kareah, and all the men who spoke said to Jeremiah, You are lying! The Lord did not send you to us to say, Do not enter Egypt to live there.

verses.text: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is setting you against us, so that you will hand us over to the Chaldeans, to put us to death and have us deported to Babylon.
verses.display_text: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is setting you against us, so that you will hand us over to the Chaldeans, to put us to death and have us deported to Babylon.

verses.text: Johanan, all the commanders of the force, and all the people did not obey the Lord’s voice by remaining in Judah’s land.
verses.display_text: Johanan, all the commanders of the force, and all the people did not obey the Lord’s voice by remaining in Judah’s land.

verses.text: Johanan and all the commanders of the force took all Judah’s survivors who had returned to live in the land:
verses.display_text: Johanan and all the commanders of the force took all Judah’s survivors who had returned to live in the land:

verses.text: the mighty men, the women, the little children, the king’s daughters, the people Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.
verses.display_text: the mighty men, the women, the little children, the king’s daughters, the people Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.

verses.text: They entered Egypt, for they had not obeyed the Lord’s voice. They entered Taphnas.
verses.display_text: They entered Egypt, for they had not obeyed the Lord’s voice. They entered Taphnas.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah at Taphnas:
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to Jeremiah at Taphnas:

verses.text: Take large stones for yourself and hide them in the forecourt at the gate of Pharaoh’s house at Taphnas, before the eyes of Judah’s men.
verses.display_text: Take large stones for yourself and hide them in the forecourt at the gate of Pharaoh’s house at Taphnas, before the eyes of Judah’s men.

verses.text: Say, Thus said the Lord: I am sending and will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will place his throne above these stones that you hid and raise his weapons over them.
verses.display_text: Say, Thus said the Lord: I am sending and will bring Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will place his throne above these stones that you hid and raise his weapons over them.

verses.text: He will enter and strike Egypt’s land: those for death, to death; those for deportation, to deportation; and those for the sword, to the sword.
verses.display_text: He will enter and strike Egypt’s land: those for death, to death; those for deportation, to deportation; and those for the sword, to the sword.

verses.text: He will kindle fire in the houses of their gods, burn the houses, and deport the gods. He will delouse Egypt’s land as a shepherd delouses his garment, and he will go out in peace.
verses.display_text: He will kindle fire in the houses of their gods, burn the houses, and deport the gods. He will delouse Egypt’s land as a shepherd delouses his garment, and he will go out in peace.

verses.text: He will shatter the pillars of the City of the Sun, those in On, and burn their houses with fire.
verses.display_text: He will shatter the pillars of the City of the Sun, those in On, and burn their houses with fire.

verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Judeans living in Egypt’s land and those staying at Migdol, Taphnas, and in Pathoures’s land:
verses.display_text: The word that came to Jeremiah for all the Judeans living in Egypt’s land and those staying at Migdol, Taphnas, and in Pathoures’s land:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You have seen all the calamities I brought upon Jerusalem and Judah’s cities. Behold, they are deserted of inhabitants,
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You have seen all the calamities I brought upon Jerusalem and Judah’s cities. Behold, they are deserted of inhabitants,

verses.text: because of the wickedness they committed to embitter Me, going to burn incense to other gods whom you did not know.
verses.display_text: because of the wickedness they committed to embitter Me, going to burn incense to other gods whom you did not know.

verses.text: I sent you My servants the prophets at dawn, and I sent them saying, Do not commit this act of defilement that I hate.
verses.display_text: I sent you My servants the prophets at dawn, and I sent them saying, Do not commit this act of defilement that I hate.

verses.text: But they did not listen to Me or incline their ear to turn from their evils and stop burning incense to other gods.
verses.display_text: But they did not listen to Me or incline their ear to turn from their evils and stop burning incense to other gods.

verses.text: My anger and wrath dripped out and blazed in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, and they became a desolation and an untrodden place, as on this day.
verses.display_text: My anger and wrath dripped out and blazed in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem, and they became a desolation and an untrodden place, as on this day.

verses.text: Now thus said the Lord Almighty: Why are you doing great evils against yourselves, cutting off from yourselves man and woman, little child and nursing infant from Judah, so that none of you remains,
verses.display_text: Now thus said the Lord Almighty: Why are you doing great evils against yourselves, cutting off from yourselves man and woman, little child and nursing infant from Judah, so that none of you remains,

verses.text: embittering Me with the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in Egypt’s land, which you entered to live there, so that you are cut off and become a curse and a reproach among all the earth’s nations?
verses.display_text: embittering Me with the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in Egypt’s land, which you entered to live there, so that you are cut off and become a curse and a reproach among all the earth’s nations?

verses.text: Have you forgotten your fathers’ evils, the evils of Judah’s kings, your rulers’ evils, and your wives’ evils, which they committed in Judah’s land and outside Jerusalem?
verses.display_text: Have you forgotten your fathers’ evils, the evils of Judah’s kings, your rulers’ evils, and your wives’ evils, which they committed in Judah’s land and outside Jerusalem?

verses.text: They have not stopped to this day and have not held fast to My ordinances, which I set before their fathers.
verses.display_text: They have not stopped to this day and have not held fast to My ordinances, which I set before their fathers.

verses.text: Therefore thus said the Lord: I am setting My face
verses.display_text: Therefore thus said the Lord: I am setting My face

verses.text: to destroy all the survivors in Egypt, and they will fall. By sword and famine they will perish, from the least to the greatest, and become a reproach, a destruction, and a curse.
verses.display_text: to destroy all the survivors in Egypt, and they will fall. By sword and famine they will perish, from the least to the greatest, and become a reproach, a destruction, and a curse.

verses.text: I will visit those staying in Egypt’s land as I visited Jerusalem, by sword, famine, and death.
verses.display_text: I will visit those staying in Egypt’s land as I visited Jerusalem, by sword, famine, and death.

verses.text: None of Judah’s remainder residing in Egypt’s land will be saved to return to Judah’s land, where they hope in their souls to return. They certainly will not return except those rescued.
verses.display_text: None of Judah’s remainder residing in Egypt’s land will be saved to return to Judah’s land, where they hope in their souls to return. They certainly will not return except those rescued.

verses.text: All the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, all the women, a great assembly, and all the people staying in Egypt’s land at Pathoures answered Jeremiah:
verses.display_text: All the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, all the women, a great assembly, and all the people staying in Egypt’s land at Pathoures answered Jeremiah:

verses.text: As for the word you spoke to us in the Lord’s name, we will not listen to you.
verses.display_text: As for the word you spoke to us in the Lord’s name, we will not listen to you.

verses.text: We will certainly do everything that will come from our mouths: burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we, our fathers, our kings, and our rulers did in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem. We were filled with bread, were well off, and saw no calamities.
verses.display_text: We will certainly do everything that will come from our mouths: burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her, as we, our fathers, our kings, and our rulers did in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem. We were filled with bread, were well off, and saw no calamities.

verses.text: But when we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven, we were all diminished and perished by sword and famine.
verses.display_text: But when we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven, we were all diminished and perished by sword and famine.

verses.text: And when we burn incense to the queen of heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make cakes for her and pour out drink offerings to her without our husbands?
verses.display_text: And when we burn incense to the queen of heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make cakes for her and pour out drink offerings to her without our husbands?

verses.text: Jeremiah said to all the people—to the mighty men, the women, and all the people who had answered him:
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to all the people—to the mighty men, the women, and all the people who had answered him:

verses.text: Was it not the incense you burned in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your rulers, and the people of the land—that the Lord remembered, and did it not come into His heart?
verses.display_text: Was it not the incense you burned in Judah’s cities and outside Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your rulers, and the people of the land—that the Lord remembered, and did it not come into His heart?

verses.text: The Lord could no longer bear the wickedness of your actions and the abominations you had committed. Your land became a desolation, an untrodden place, and a curse, as on this day,
verses.display_text: The Lord could no longer bear the wickedness of your actions and the abominations you had committed. Your land became a desolation, an untrodden place, and a curse, as on this day,

verses.text: because you burned incense, sinned against the Lord, did not obey the Lord’s voice, and did not walk in His ordinances, law, and testimonies. These calamities have seized you.
verses.display_text: because you burned incense, sinned against the Lord, did not obey the Lord’s voice, and did not walk in His ordinances, law, and testimonies. These calamities have seized you.

verses.text: Jeremiah said to the people and the women, Hear the Lord’s word:
verses.display_text: Jeremiah said to the people and the women, Hear the Lord’s word:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You women spoke with your mouths and fulfilled it with your hands, saying, We will certainly carry out our pledges that we pledged, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her. You firmly persisted in your pledges and indeed carried them out.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord, Israel’s God: You women spoke with your mouths and fulfilled it with your hands, saying, We will certainly carry out our pledges that we pledged, to burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her. You firmly persisted in your pledges and indeed carried them out.

verses.text: Therefore hear the Lord’s word, all Judah staying in Egypt’s land: I have sworn by My great name, said the Lord, that My name will no longer be in any Judean’s mouth to say, As the Lord, the Lord, lives, throughout Egypt’s land.
verses.display_text: Therefore hear the Lord’s word, all Judah staying in Egypt’s land: I have sworn by My great name, said the Lord, that My name will no longer be in any Judean’s mouth to say, As the Lord, the Lord, lives, throughout Egypt’s land.

verses.text: For I am watching over them to harm them, not do them good. All Judah living in Egypt’s land will perish by sword and famine until they perish.
verses.display_text: For I am watching over them to harm them, not do them good. All Judah living in Egypt’s land will perish by sword and famine until they perish.

verses.text: Those saved from the sword will return to Judah’s land, few in number. Judah’s survivors who settled in Egypt’s land to live there will know whose word will endure.
verses.display_text: Those saved from the sword will return to Judah’s land, few in number. Judah’s survivors who settled in Egypt’s land to live there will know whose word will endure.

verses.text: This will be the sign for you that I will visit you for evils:
verses.display_text: This will be the sign for you that I will visit you for evils:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord: I am handing Ouaphre king of Egypt over to his enemy and those seeking his life, as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy who sought his life.
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord: I am handing Ouaphre king of Egypt over to his enemy and those seeking his life, as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, his enemy who sought his life.

verses.text: The word Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words in the scroll from Jeremiah’s mouth, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:
verses.display_text: The word Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch son of Neriah when he wrote these words in the scroll from Jeremiah’s mouth, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

verses.text: Thus said the Lord concerning you, Baruch:
verses.display_text: Thus said the Lord concerning you, Baruch:

verses.text: For you said, Woe to me, woe to me! The Lord has added toil to my pain. I lay down amid groanings and found no rest.
verses.display_text: For you said, Woe to me, woe to me! The Lord has added toil to my pain. I lay down amid groanings and found no rest.

verses.text: Tell him, Thus said the Lord: Those I have built up I am tearing down, and those I have planted I am plucking up.
verses.display_text: Tell him, Thus said the Lord: Those I have built up I am tearing down, and those I have planted I am plucking up.

verses.text: Are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them, for I am bringing calamities upon all flesh, says the Lord. I will give your life as gain wherever you walk.
verses.display_text: Are you seeking great things for yourself? Do not seek them, for I am bringing calamities upon all flesh, says the Lord. I will give your life as gain wherever you walk.

verses.text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Amitaal daughter of Jeremiah, from Lobena.
verses.display_text: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Amitaal daughter of Jeremiah, from Lobena.

verses.text: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his force came against Jerusalem. They enclosed her with a palisade and built around her with squared stones.
verses.display_text: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his force came against Jerusalem. They enclosed her with a palisade and built around her with squared stones.

verses.text: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
verses.display_text: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.text: On the ninth of the month, the famine grew severe in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.
verses.display_text: On the ninth of the month, the famine grew severe in the city, and there were no loaves for the people of the land.

verses.text: The city was breached, and all the warriors went out at night by the gate between the wall and the outer wall beside the king’s garden, while the Chaldeans surrounded the city. They went by the road to Arabah,
verses.display_text: The city was breached, and all the warriors went out at night by the gate between the wall and the outer wall beside the king’s garden, while the Chaldeans surrounded the city. They went by the road to Arabah,

verses.text: and the Chaldean force pursued the king and overtook him beyond Jericho. All his servants scattered away from him.
verses.display_text: and the Chaldean force pursued the king and overtook him beyond Jericho. All his servants scattered away from him.

verses.text: They captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Deblatha, and he spoke to him in judgment.
verses.display_text: They captured the king and brought him to the king of Babylon at Deblatha, and he spoke to him in judgment.

verses.text: The king of Babylon slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, and he slaughtered all Judah’s rulers at Deblatha.
verses.display_text: The king of Babylon slaughtered Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, and he slaughtered all Judah’s rulers at Deblatha.

verses.text: He blinded Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters. The king of Babylon brought him to Babylon and put him in a mill house until the day he died.
verses.display_text: He blinded Zedekiah’s eyes and bound him in fetters. The king of Babylon brought him to Babylon and put him in a mill house until the day he died.

verses.text: In the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuzaradan, the chief guard who stood before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: In the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuzaradan, the chief guard who stood before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.text: He burned the Lord’s house, the king’s house, and all the city’s houses; every great house he burned with fire.
verses.display_text: He burned the Lord’s house, the king’s house, and all the city’s houses; every great house he burned with fire.

verses.text: The Chaldean force with the chief guard pulled down the whole wall of Jerusalem all around.
verses.display_text: The Chaldean force with the chief guard pulled down the whole wall of Jerusalem all around.

verses.text: The chief guard left the remaining people as vinedressers and farmers.
verses.display_text: The chief guard left the remaining people as vinedressers and farmers.

verses.text: The Chaldeans shattered the bronze pillars in the Lord’s house, the bases, and the bronze Sea in the Lord’s house. They took their bronze and carried it to Babylon.
verses.display_text: The Chaldeans shattered the bronze pillars in the Lord’s house, the bases, and the bronze Sea in the Lord’s house. They took their bronze and carried it to Babylon.

verses.text: And the rim, the bowls, the meat forks, and all the bronze utensils with which they performed service,
verses.display_text: And the rim, the bowls, the meat forks, and all the bronze utensils with which they performed service,

verses.text: and the saphphoth, the masmaroth, the pouring vessels, the lampstands, the incense bowls, and the ladles—those of gold, gold, and those of silver, silver—the chief guard took.
verses.display_text: and the saphphoth, the masmaroth, the pouring vessels, the lampstands, the incense bowls, and the ladles—those of gold, gold, and those of silver, silver—the chief guard took.

verses.text: The two pillars, the one Sea, and the twelve bronze calves beneath the Sea, which King Solomon made for the Lord’s house—their bronze was beyond weighing.
verses.display_text: The two pillars, the one Sea, and the twelve bronze calves beneath the Sea, which King Solomon made for the Lord’s house—their bronze was beyond weighing.

verses.text: As for the pillars, one pillar was thirty-five cubits high, and a cord of twelve cubits encircled it. Its thickness was four fingerbreadths all around,
verses.display_text: As for the pillars, one pillar was thirty-five cubits high, and a cord of twelve cubits encircled it. Its thickness was four fingerbreadths all around,

verses.text: and a bronze cornice was on them. The projection of one cornice was five cubits in length, and a net and pomegranates surrounded the cornice, all of bronze. The second pillar had the same: eight pomegranates per cubit over the twelve cubits.
verses.display_text: and a bronze cornice was on them. The projection of one cornice was five cubits in length, and a net and pomegranates surrounded the cornice, all of bronze. The second pillar had the same: eight pomegranates per cubit over the twelve cubits.

verses.text: There were ninety-six pomegranates on one side; all the pomegranates around the net numbered one hundred.
verses.display_text: There were ninety-six pomegranates on one side; all the pomegranates around the net numbered one hundred.

verses.text: The chief guard took the first priest, the second priest, and the three men guarding the road,
verses.display_text: The chief guard took the first priest, the second priest, and the three men guarding the road,

verses.text: and one eunuch who supervised the warriors, seven prominent men in the king’s presence who were found in the city, the scribe of the forces who kept records for the people of the land, and sixty people from the people of the land found inside the city.
verses.display_text: and one eunuch who supervised the warriors, seven prominent men in the king’s presence who were found in the city, the scribe of the forces who kept records for the people of the land, and sixty people from the people of the land found inside the city.

verses.text: Nebuzaradan, the chief guard, took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Deblatha,
verses.display_text: Nebuzaradan, the chief guard, took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Deblatha,

verses.text: and the king of Babylon struck them at Deblatha in Aimath’s land.
verses.display_text: and the king of Babylon struck them at Deblatha in Aimath’s land.

verses.text: In the thirty-seventh year after Ioakim king of Judah had been deported, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fourth of the month, Oulaimaradach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, took up the head of Ioakim king of Judah and brought him out of the house where he was guarded.
verses.display_text: In the thirty-seventh year after Ioakim king of Judah had been deported, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fourth of the month, Oulaimaradach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, took up the head of Ioakim king of Judah and brought him out of the house where he was guarded.

verses.text: He spoke kindly to him and placed his throne above the thrones of the kings with him in Babylon.
verses.display_text: He spoke kindly to him and placed his throne above the thrones of the kings with him in Babylon.

verses.text: He changed his prison robe, and he ate bread continually before him all the days he lived.
verses.display_text: He changed his prison robe, and he ate bread continually before him all the days he lived.

verses.text: His allowance was given to him continually by the king of Babylon, from day to day until the day he died.
verses.display_text: His allowance was given to him continually by the king of Babylon, from day to day until the day he died.
